data.name: Query_CheckGRNStatus
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT set_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.* FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = @poID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = @poHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @itemID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_ClosingStock
data.value:
SELECT tab.Item, sum(tab.amount) as Amount, sum (tab.Quantity) as Quantity, tab.UOMName, Avg(tab.TransactionCost) As TransactionCost, tab.GroupName FROM ( select '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description as Item, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 'GRN' AS DOCTYPE ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName from INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 LEFT join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
LEFT join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.menuID where ApplicationMenu.MenuPath like '%/Stock_frm.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate AND @Todate {0} group by INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName
UNION ALL
select '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description as Item, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 'GIN' AS DOCTYPE ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName from INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 LEFT join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID where
[ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/StockGIN_frm.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate AND @Todate {0} group by INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName
UNION ALL
select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item ,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as amount ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,sum( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as TransactionCost ,'Stock Return' AS DOCTYPE ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName from INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
LEFT join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
LEFT JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1
left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
LEFT join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
LEFT join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID where
[ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/StockReturn.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate AND @Todate {0} group by INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ) as tab
group by tab.item ,tab.UOMName ,tab.TransactionCost ,tab.DOCTYPE ,tab.GroupName

data.name: Query_ConsumptionSummary
data.value:
select abs( sum (tab.NewAmount) ) as amount,tab.MonthYear,tab.Item ,MAX( cast( tab.documentdate as date )) as DocumentDate ,CAST( datepart (month ,MIN( tab.documentdate)) +''+ datepart (year ,MIN( tab.documentdate)) as int) DateMonth ,CategoryID,Category,Catalog,ItemCatalogGroupID as CatalogID from ( select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item --,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as amount ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,cast( datename(month, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as varchar(3)) +'-'+ cast( datename(year, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as varchar(4)) as MonthYear ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName --,sum( ISNULL( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 0)) * sum( ISNULL( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ,0) ) as NewAmount ,case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs((INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS NewAmount ,CategoryID,CategoryName as Category,ItemCatalogGroupID ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as Catalog from dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact' and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join Set_CostCenter on Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID where [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (64, 12, 114,28,114, 114,28) --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @Todate --and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID = @LocationID
{0}
) tab
group by tab.MonthYear ,tab.Item,tab.Item,CategoryID,Category,Catalog,ItemCatalogGroupID order by min ( cast(tab.documentdate as date)) asc

data.name: Query_FastMovingItems
data.value:
Select INV_Item.ItemID, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName,Inv_Set_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports, INV_Item.Description,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.CompanyID, Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As LastPurDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As LastPurPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As SupplierName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As LastPurQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As LastTransactionDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As LastTransactionQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader ON Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionId = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Inv_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 {1} LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
Inner Join ( Select item.CompanyID, item.itemid, isnull(sum(sd.TransactionQuantity), 0) As TotalQuantity from inv_item item left join INV_StockTransactionDetail sd on --sd.CompanyID = item.CompanyID and sd.ItemID = item.ItemID left join INV_StockTransactionHeader sh on sh.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID And sh.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID And sh.StockTransactionID = sd.StockTransactionID {0} group by item.CompanyID, item.ItemID having isnull(sum(sd.TransactionQuantity), 0) >= @MovedQuantity ) AS FastMovingItems on --INV_Item.CompanyID = FastMovingItems.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = FastMovingItems.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct PurchaseOrder.CompanyID, PurchaseOrder.ItemID, PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = PurchaseOrder.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PurchaseOrder.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate = PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate = PurchaseOrder.PODate Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID And And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastTransactionInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastTransactionInfo.ItemID Where INV_Item.Status = 1 --and INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID and LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType <> 'Requisition' and LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType <> 'GIN' and LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType <> 'Transfer In' and LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType <> 'Transfer Out' and LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType <> 'Dispatch(FA)' {2} Group by INV_Item.ItemID, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName,Inv_Set_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.CompanyID, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode Order by INV_Item.Description

data.name: Query_GoodsRecieveDollarRate
data.value: SELECT SET_Term.Description as Terms, convert (varchar(20), POH.DocumentDate, 106) as PODate, AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo as RequisitionNo, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice as DollarPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as PKRPrice, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo DCNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate DC_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as PONo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as GRNDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemDescription, INV_Item.Description) as Description, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, ISNULL( (select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Location ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = SET_Location.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader POH on INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = POH.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = POH.DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = POH.TypeCode left join SET_Term on SET_Term.TermID = POH.TermsID and SET_Term.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_Item POItem ON --POItem.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And POItem.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID Inner Join INV_SET_Category POCategory On POCategory.CategoryID = POItem.ItemTypeID --AND POCategory.CompanyID = POItem.CompanyID left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%Stock_frm.aspx%') {0} order by INV_Item.Description

data.name: Query_ItemWiseClosingStockReport
data.value: Select INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategory,inv_set_category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName AS UOM, INV_Item.CompanyID, Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As PODate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As POPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As POSupplier, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As POQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As StockTransDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As StockTransQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 And (Inv_Set_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR Inv_Set_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.WeightUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID Left Join ( Select Distinct PurchaseOrder.CompanyID, PurchaseOrder.ItemID, PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 {PurchaseFilter} Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = PurchaseOrder.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PurchaseOrder.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate = PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate = PurchaseOrder.PODate Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID And And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {StockFilter} Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID Where (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @TransactionType Or @TransactionType is null) ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastTransactionInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastTransactionInfo.ItemID Where INV_Item.Status = 1 --and INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID And (Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) And INV_Item.Description like '%' + @ItemFilter + '%' And ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') And INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName,inv_set_category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.CompanyID Order by INV_Item.Description

then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End ) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = PurchaseOrder.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PurchaseOrder.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate = PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate = PurchaseOrder.PODate Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID And And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastTransactionInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastTransactionInfo.ItemID Where INV_Item.Status = 1 and INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID {DateFilter} {1} ---- Remove Condition ...b/c Records were not showing --- Adnan Raza -- And not exists (Select * from INV_StockTransactionDetail -- Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- And INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 -- And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 -- where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = inv_item.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = inv_item.ItemID -- And select * from ( select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description as Item, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRN_No, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity as PO_Quantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) as GRN_Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as ApprovedGRN_Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity as RejectedGRN_Quantity, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as RemainingQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate, round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) as PO_Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GRN_Amount, 0 as BalanceAmount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,
isnull((select sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from AR_InvoiceDetail inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID where AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status =1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 ),0) as QuantityInvoiced,
--0 as QuantityInvoiced, --AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, 0 as AmountPaid, CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) as InvoiceDate, --AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as InvoiceNo, 0 as InvoiceNo,
DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType ,[SET_DocumentType2].DocumentType AS PODocumentType
,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue as PurchaserName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as GRNDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ,datediff(DAY,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,getdate()) as NoofDays, CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 THEN 'Approved' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 5 THEN 'InProcess' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 12 THEN 'ReleaseForApprove' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 13 THEN 'PartiallyApproved' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 14 THEN 'Discuss' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 15 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 16 THEN 'Reversed' WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 17 THEN 'NoOrder' END AS StatusCode from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ANd INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.status = 1 INNER join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].MenuID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status =1 INNER join SET_DocumentType [SET_DocumentType2] on [SET_DocumentType2].DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and [SET_DocumentType2].CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType2].PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType2].Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup [DocumentTypesGroup2] On [DocumentTypesGroup2].GroupID = Set_DocumentType2.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT Join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status =1
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- (only approved GRN appeared) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ClosedCode > 2 --(coz Inprocess Invoice not showing) and [ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/Stock_frm.aspx' and ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionHeader].IsReversed, 0) != 1
{0}

INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost , round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) , INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount , round((AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, 3), INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) , AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType, [SET_DocumentType2].DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode having isnull(( select sum(indtl.QuantityInvoiced) from AR_InvoiceHeader invHdr inner join AR_InvoiceDetail indtl on indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID and indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID and indtl.CompanyID = invHdr.CompanyID and indtl.PeriodID = invHdr.PeriodID and indtl.Status = 1 and invHdr.StatusCode = 1 where indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and indtl.InvoiceDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and indtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and indtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID ),0 ) <> INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity
)tab order by Supplier, GRN_No --where tab.QuantityInvoiced <> tab.TransactionQuantity

data.name: Query_Select_By_dispatchID_CompanyId_PeriodId
data.value:
SELECT distinct [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID], [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] ,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [Quantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AS [DeliveryOrderHeaderID] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AS [DeliveryOrderDetailID] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SerialNo] ,[SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] ,[SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.DispatchItemID ,dispatchItem.Description as DispatchItem ,[SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] ,[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo] ,[SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Quantity] AS [BaseQuantity] ,[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] ,[SAL_OrderDetail].[BaseAmount] ,[SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] ,([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] * [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Quantity]) AS [NetAmount] ,([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] * [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Quantity]) AS [Amount] ,[INV_SET_Category].[CategoryName] ,[INV_Item].[Description] ,[SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName] ,Set_Batch.Description as Batch ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] ,ISNULL([INV_Item].ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit ,ISNULL(ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate], IsNull([INV_Item].ListPricePerUnit, 0)) * (Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity])), 0) AS TotalAmount, '' as [Action] ,[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DocumentTypeID as DODocumentTypeID ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[LocationID] ,[set_location].[LocationName] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID],set_rack.RackName,[SAL_OrderDetail].Inclusive ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks, isnull((Select (Quantity - ABS(TransactionQuantity)) as RemainingQty from ( Select SourceCode,SourceHeaderID,Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity , [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] inner JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
inner JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] SalDaliveryOrder ON SalDaliveryOrder.[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.DocumentTypeID =[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID AND SalDaliveryOrder.[Status] = 1
inner Join [INV_StockTransactionHeader] on [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].Status=1
Where SalDaliveryOrder.DeliveryOrderID=[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderID and SalDaliveryOrder.CompanyID=[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].CompanyID And [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Status=1 Group By SourceCode,SourceHeaderID,[SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity ) as RemainingQty), [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity)RemainingQty, isnull((Select (Quantity - ABS(TransactionQuantity)) as RemainingQuantity from ( Select SourceCode,SourceHeaderID,Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity , [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity from [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] inner JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1
inner JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] SalDaliveryOrder ON SalDaliveryOrder.[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SalDaliveryOrder.DocumentTypeID =[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID AND SalDaliveryOrder.[Status] = 1
inner Join [INV_StockTransactionHeader] on [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StockTransactionID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 And [INV_StockTransactionHeader].Status=1
Where SalDaliveryOrder.DeliveryOrderID=[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].DeliveryOrderID and SalDaliveryOrder.CompanyID=[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].CompanyID And [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Status=1 Group By SourceCode,SourceHeaderID,[SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity ) as RemainingQuantity), [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity)RemainingQuantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID When 1 then 'Medium' When 2 then 'Bold' When 3 then 'Fine' else '' end AS GrainSizeName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID When 1 then 'With_InnerLiner' When 2 then 'Without_InnerLiner' else '' end AS PackingName FROM [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON data.value:
SELECT [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[PODetailID],[AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[POHeaderID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CompanyID], AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[TypeCode], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[PeriodID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[AllowPriceOverrideFlag],[AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[BaseQuantity], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[BaseUOMID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CancelledDate], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CancelledFlag], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CancelledReason], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CancelledBy], ISNULL([AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CapitalExpenseFlag],0)CapitalExpenseFlag, [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CategoryID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ClosedBy], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ClosedCode], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ClosedDate], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ClosedFlag], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ClosedReason], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CommittedAmount], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ContractNumber], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ExpirationDate], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[FromHeaderID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[FromDetailID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[HazardClassID], inv_item.description as [ItemDescription], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ItemID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ItemRevision], [inv_Item].[PrimaryUOMCode] as ItemUOMID, [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ListPricePerUnit], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[MarketPrice], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[MaxOrderQuantity], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[MinOrderQuantity], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[MinReleaseAmount], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[NegotiatedByPreparerFlag], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[NotToExceedPrice], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[NoteToVendor], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[OverToleranceErrorFlag], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[PriceTypeCode], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[QtyRcvTolerance], -- [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity],
([AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity] - (select isnull(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail where SourceCode=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and SourceDocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SourceHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID )) as Quantity,
[AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[QuantityCommitted], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[SecondaryQuantity], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[SecondaryUOMID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[SerialNo], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[TaxID], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[TaxName], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[TaxableFlag], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[TransactionReasonCode], (case when [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].Rate IS NOT NULL THEN [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UnitPrice] * [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].Rate ELSE [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UnitPrice] END ) UnitPrice, --[AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity] * [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UnitPrice] as GrossAmount,
(case when [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].Rate IS NOT NULL then [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity] * [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UnitPrice] * [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].Rate else [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity] * [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UnitPrice]
end ) as GrossAmount,
ISNULL([AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].DiscountAmount,0) as DiscountAmount,
[AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UnorderedFlag], isnull([AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[Rate],0) as Rate, [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[VendorProductNumber], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Status], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CreatedBy], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CreateDate], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CreatedByValue], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UpdatedBy], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UpdateDate], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[UpdatedByValue], [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[IsActive], inv_item.description as Description, [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryName], [AR_SET_Tax].[TaxName] AS 'TaxNames', '' [Action] ,-99 [RackID], '' [RackName] , [INV_Item].InventoryItemStatusCode,[AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].QtyRcvTolerance
,([AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity] - (select isnull(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail where SourceCode=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and SourceDocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SourceHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID )) * (isnull([INV_Item].QtyRcvTolerancePercent,0)) /100 + ([AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Quantity] - (select isnull(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity),0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail where SourceCode=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and SourceDocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SourceHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID )) as ToleranceQty
, '' as Remarks ,Specs FROM [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail] INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CompanyID] LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[ItemUOMID] LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CategoryID --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [AR_SET_Tax] ON [AR_SET_Tax].[TaxID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[TaxID] AND [AR_SET_Tax].[CompanyID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [AR_SET_Tax].[PeriodID] = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[PeriodID]
INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[POHeaderID] AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].PeriodID
LEFT JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
Left join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID = PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID and PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationDetailID = [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].FromDetailID
where [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[POHeaderID] = @POHeaderID and [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[Status] = @Status order by [AP_PurchaseOrderDetail].[SerialNo] asc

Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY FinTab.TransactionDetailID asc) RowUniqueID,0 as AlreadyProcessedQuantity, FinTab.* From ( SELECT Distinct INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost AS LastRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, Abs((case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ArrivedQuantity is null OR INV_StockTransactionDetail.ArrivedQuantity = 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity else INV_StockTransactionDetail.ArrivedQuantity end)) AS ArrivedQuantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReasonLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DistributionAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NewCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QuantityAdjusted, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EmployeeCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.VendorLotNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShipmentNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.WayBillAirBill, INV_StockTransactionDetail.FreightCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoofContainers, Round(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,2)ValueChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PercentageChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReservationLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, --ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.POQuantity, 2) AS POQuantity, --ROUND((AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.POQuantity,0)), 2) as POQuantity,
--ROUND(( --AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity --- --(select isnull(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail2.TransactionQuantity),0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail as INV_StockTransactionDetail2 where INV_StockTransactionDetail2.SourceCode=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode --and INV_StockTransactionDetail2.SourceDocumentTypeID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionDetail2.SourceHeaderID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail2.status = 1 --and INV_StockTransactionDetail2.Itemid = INV_StockTransactionDetail.Itemid --and INV_StockTransactionDetail2.StockTransactionID <> INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID --)
--+ --isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0) --), 2) as POQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.POQuantity,
ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierDCQuantity, 4) AS SupplierDCQuantity, ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ActualReceivedQuantity, 4) AS ActualReceivedQuantity, ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShortQuantity,4) AS ShortQuantity, ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity,4)AS RejectedQuantity,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ShelfReference, Set_Location.LocationID, Set_Location.LocationName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_Item.CostOfSalesAccountCCID AS AccountGINCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, '' AcceptQty, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID, SET_Rack.RackName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QualityID, '' as QualityName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID as ShiftHeaderID, Cane_shift.[Description] as ShiftDescription, convert(varchar(50), AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo) as DocumentNo, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, convert(bit, 'true') as DeleteCheck, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.QtyRcvTolerance, isnull(Round(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Rate,2),0) as rate ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ExpiryDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.BatchId, (select description from dbo.Set_Batch where companyid = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and periodid =INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and batchid =INV_StockTransactionDetail.BatchId) BatchName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CustomDutyID, BPCD.CustomerName as BPCustomDuty, Round(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CustomDuty,2)CustomDuty,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ClearingChargesID,BPCC.CustomerName as BPClearingCharges, Round(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ClearingCharges,2)ClearingCharges,INV_StockTransactionDetail.OtherChargesID,BPOC.CustomerName as BPOtherCharges, Round(INV_StockTransactionDetail.OtherCharges,2)OtherCharges ,Round(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CustomDutyRates,2)CustomDutyRates,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ClearingChargesRates ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.BatchNo --,(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * (isnull(INV_Item.QtyRcvTolerancePercent,0) /100)) as ToleranceQty, , case when Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) > 0 then (Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * (isnull(INV_Item.QtyRcvTolerancePercent,0) /100)) else (ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity,4) + ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity,4) * (isnull(INV_Item.QtyRcvTolerancePercent,0) /100)) end as ToleranceQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks ,ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CapitalExpenseFlag,0)CapitalExpenseFlag , '' as Specs FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID left join SET_Rack on INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID=SET_Rack.RackID left join cane_shift on INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID = cane_shift.ShiftHeaderID Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode
Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BPCD ON BPCD.CustomerID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.CustomDutyID AND BPCD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND BPCD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BPCC ON BPCC.CustomerID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.ClearingChargesID --AND BPCC.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND BPCC.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BPOC ON BPOC.CustomerID= INV_StockTransactionDetail.OtherChargesID --AND BPOC.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND BPOC.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition On AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumenttypeID where [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = @StockTransactionID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = @Status ) As FinTab order by FinTab.SerialNo asc

2) AS ActualReceivedQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShortQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, INV_Item.Description, Set_Location.LocationID, Set_Location.LocationName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_Item.CostOfSalesAccountCCID AS AccountGINCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, '' AcceptQty, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID, SET_Rack.RackName, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.QtyRcvTolerance , INV_StockTransactionDetail.ExpiryDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.BatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StrikeNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNoFrom,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNoTo ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftingThroughID, case when (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftingThroughID) = 1 then 'ConveyorBelt' When (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftingThroughID) = 2 then 'TwoWheel' when (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftingThroughID) = 3 then 'Tractor' else 'Select' End as ShiftingThroughName ,ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CapitalExpenseFlag,0)CapitalExpenseFlag ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID When 1 then 'Medium' When 2 then 'Bold' INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID left join SET_Rack on INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID = SET_Rack.RackID Left Join Set_Quality On INV_StockTransactionDetail.QualityID = Set_Quality.QualityID left join HRMS_Set_Shift on INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID = HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition On AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumenttypeID where [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = @StockTransactionID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = @Status ) As FinTab order by FinTab.[SerialNo] asc
