INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID, Item.Description +' '+isnull(Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,'') Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsMajor, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode, (Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END) Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsDone, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, ( -- select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) -- As SumOfQuantityInStock -- from INV_StockTransactionDetail --Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID -- And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = 1 -- And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact'
select sum(SumOfQuantityInStock ) from ( select --IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock case when StkDetail.ImpactID is not null then case StkDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end As SumOfQuantityInStock
from INV_StockTransactionDetail StkDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader StkHdr On StkHdr.StockTransactionID = StkDetail.StockTransactionID AND StkHdr.CompanyID = StkDetail.CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StkHdr.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StkHdr.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = StkHdr.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [StkDetail].LocationID
where StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And StkHdr.Status = 1 --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID is null) AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND StkDetail.IsActive = 1 AND StkHdr.StatusCode = 1 AND StkHdr.ReversalID IS NULL group by StkDetail.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,StkHdr.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType )as tab ) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) ) LastConsumption, ( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID as DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.Description as IncurredDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsIncurred, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks, Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName as Location, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) TransactionCost --, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) as CustomAmount, ,(Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END) CustomAmount, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.NoImpactQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,SET_Rack.RackName,INV_StockTransactionDetail.NetAmount ,Item.CodeCombinationID, Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail2.Description as CodeDescription2 ,Item.ItemCatalogGroupID as ItemCatalogID ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogDescription FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 Left Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Item.CodeCombinationID and Item.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID and Item.Status = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail GL_CodeCombinationDetail2 on GL_CodeCombinationDetail2.CodeCombinationID = Item.ExpenseAccountCCID and Item.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail2.CompanyID and Item.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 order by INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID asc

Query_SlowMovingItems
data.value: Select INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.CompanyID, Sum( case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End ) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As LastPurDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As LastPurPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As SupplierName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As LastPurQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As LastTransactionDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As LastTransactionQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader ON Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionId = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Inv_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join ( Select item.CompanyID, item.itemid, isnull(sum(sd.TransactionQuantity), 0) As TotalQuantity from inv_item item left join INV_StockTransactionDetail sd on --sd.CompanyID = item.CompanyID and sd.ItemID = item.ItemID left join INV_StockTransactionHeader sh on sh.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID And sh.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID And sh.StockTransactionID = sd.StockTransactionID Where (sh.DocumentDate between @FromDate And @ToDate) group by item.CompanyID, item.ItemID having isnull(sum(sd.TransactionQuantity), 0) <= @MovedQuantity ) AS SlowMovingItems on --INV_Item.CompanyID = SlowMovingItems.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = SlowMovingItems.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct PurchaseOrder.CompanyID, PurchaseOrder.ItemID, PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = PurchaseOrder.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PurchaseOrder.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate = PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate = PurchaseOrder.PODate Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID And And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastTransactionInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastTransactionInfo.ItemID Where INV_Item.Status = 1 --and INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} {1} Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.CompanyID Order by INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_Item.Description

data.name: Query_Stock
data.value: Select INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategory,inv_set_category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName AS UOM, INV_Item.CompanyID, Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As PODate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As POPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As POSupplier, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As POQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As StockTransDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As StockTransQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 And (Inv_Set_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR Inv_Set_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.WeightUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID Left Join ( Select Distinct PurchaseOrder.CompanyID, PurchaseOrder.ItemID, PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 {PurchaseFilter} Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = PurchaseOrder.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PurchaseOrder.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate = PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate = PurchaseOrder.PODate Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID And And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {StockFilter} Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID Where (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @TransactionType Or @TransactionType is null) ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastTransactionInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastTransactionInfo.ItemID Where INV_Item.Status = 1 and --INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID And (Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) And INV_Item.Description like '%' + @ItemFilter + '%' And ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') And INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} {1} Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName,inv_set_category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.CompanyID Order by INV_Item.Description

data.value:
Select TOP 7 INV_Item.ItemID, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategory, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName AS UOM, INV_Item.CompanyID, IsNull(Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As PODate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As POPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As POSupplier, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As POQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As StockTransDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As StockTransQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID
Left Join ( Select Distinct PurchaseOrder.CompanyID, PurchaseOrder.ItemID, PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 {PurchaseFilter} Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {StockFilter} Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID Where (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @TransactionType Or @TransactionType is null) ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, data.name: Query_StockVerificationStatements
data.value:
Select INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategory, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName AS UOM, INV_Item.CompanyID, Sum( case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End ) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As PODate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As POPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As POSupplier, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As POQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As StockTransDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As StockTransQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID
Left Join ( Select Distinct PurchaseOrder.CompanyID, PurchaseOrder.ItemID, PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity From AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Inner Join ( Select AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate) As PurchaseOrderDate, Max(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate) As PODate from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.IsActive = 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 And (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate <= @PurchaseDate Or @PurchaseDate is null) And (AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = @LastPurchaseSupplier Or @LastPurchaseSupplier is null) Group by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID ) As PurchaseOrder On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = PurchaseOrder.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = PurchaseOrder.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PurchaseOrder.ItemID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate = PurchaseOrder.PurchaseOrderDate And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate = PurchaseOrder.PODate Inner Join AR_SET_Customer On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID And And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID ANd AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 ) As LastPurchaseInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastPurchaseInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastPurchaseInfo.ItemID Left Join ( Select Distinct StockHeader.CompanyID, StockHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, StockHeader.StockDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost As StockTransPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join ( Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) As StockDate, Max(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate) As StockCreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @StockDate Or @StockDate is null) Group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid ) As StockHeader On INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = StockHeader.ItemID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = StockHeader.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = StockHeader.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = StockHeader.StockDate And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate = StockHeader.StockCreateDate Inner Join SET_DocumentType On INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID Where (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @TransactionType Or @TransactionType is null) ) As LastTransactionInfo On --INV_Item.CompanyID = LastTransactionInfo.CompanyID And INV_Item.ItemID = LastTransactionInfo.ItemID Where INV_Item.Status = 1 --and INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID And (Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) And INV_Item.Description like '%' + @ItemFilter + '%' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
And ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact')
{0}
Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate, LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.CompanyID Order by Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description

data.name: Query_Stock_Ledger
data.value:
Select * from ( Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,
--cast(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,120)+' '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),INV_StockTransactionHeader.createdate,108) as datetime) DocumentDate,
INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,
SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as TransactionQuantity, 0 as TransactionCost, 0 AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount, 'opening' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,'' as DepartmentName ,'' as GL_Code,(CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments LIKE 'IR#%' AND LEN(INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments) <= 12 THEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ELSE '' END) AS Comments FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader .CompanyID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0}
AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ) as TAB {1}
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity,
--Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, ( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) - (( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1) ) / 100) ) as TransactionCost,
( (CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN -- Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) ELSE --AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) END ) - (( (CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN -- Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) as UnitPrice,
--SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) AS Amount,
( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) - (( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) AS Amount,
--SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity,
CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName
--, isnull(( --select top 1 GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID --from GL_TransactionHeader --inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID --and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID --and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID --where GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo --and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID --and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID --and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
--),'') as GL_Code
,isnull(( select INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID from INV_Item where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID
),'') as GL_Code,(CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments LIKE 'IR#%' AND LEN(INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments) <= 12 THEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ELSE '' END) AS Comments
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') ) inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader .CompanyID left join SET_Department on set_department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb where fintab.transactionquantity <> 0
---------------------------------------------------
Union All Select '' as IsCancelled, 0 as Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, ItemID, Description as ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, '' as LocationName ,'' as DocumentNo, '' as DocumentDate,'DummyDoc' as DocumentType, 0 as TransactionQuantity,0 as TransactionCost, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as Amount , '' as TransactionImpact,InventoryItemStatusCode,0 as UnitQuantity,'' as CreateDate, 0 as StockTransactionID, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName, 0 as TransactionDetailID ,'' as DepartmentName ,'' as GL_Code, '' as Comments from INV_Item Inner Join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_Item .CompanyID {4} {2}
Select Fintab.ItemDescription, SUM(Fintab.Discount) as Discount,SUM(OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty, SUM(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount, Fintab.ItemID,SUM(OpeningBalanceRate) as OpeningBalanceRate From ( select tab.Description as ItemDescription, tab.Discount,
sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty, Sum(TAB.OpeningAmount) - Discount as OpeningAmount,
--case when sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 then 0 else --sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceRate) / sum(Tab.OpeningBalanceQty)
--end as OpeningBalanceRate,
TAB.ItemID ,avg(TAB.TransactionCost)OpeningBalanceRate FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate,
(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End)* INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost --(case when std.TransactionQuantity > 0 then std.TransactionCost else ISNULL(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost) -- END) as OpeningAmount,
ISNULL(((((case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End)* INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1),0)) / 100),0) AS Discount,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID) LocationID ,case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else null end as TransactionCost
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) --GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description, tab.Discount ) as Fintab group by Fintab.ItemID,Fintab.ItemDescription

data.name: Query_GetDataByKeyWithOtherTablesForDirectDispatch
data.value:
Select INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NetAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTaxLiable, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID as OrderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID as OrderDetailID, [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] as ItemCategoryID, [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName, [INV_Item].ItemID, [INV_Item].Description, [SET_UnitofMeasure].UOMID as ItemUnitID, [SET_UnitofMeasure].UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END),0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = [INV_Item].[ItemID] And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = Sal_DispatchHeader.LocationID ) As CurrentStock, '' as ColorID, '' as ColorName, '' as Batch, Case When (AR_Set_Customer.FixedDiscount IS NOT NULL AND AR_Set_Customer.FixedDiscount > 0) THEN (INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount * INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax) / 100 ELSE ((INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount - INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax) / 100 END as SalesTaxAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity as ItemUnitQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity as Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost as BaseAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GrossAmount, SET_Rack.RackName,INV_StockTransactionDetail.AssetInfoID, (FA_AssetInformation.tagprefix+'-'+FA_AssetInformation.tagnumber) as TagName,INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepreciatedAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.FA_SellingPrice,'' as Action From INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[TransactionUOMID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN Sal_DispatchHeader ON Sal_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID INNER JOIN AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_DispatchHeader.PeriodID --AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = Sal_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEFT JOIN SET_Rack on INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID = SET_Rack.RackID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetInformation ON FA_AssetInformation.AssetInfoID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.AssetInfoID AND FA_AssetInformation.Status=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID
where Sal_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.DispatchID = @DispatchID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.status = 1
