select * from ( SELECT Convert(smallint, '1') as ChkSelect, Convert(smallint, STD.SerialNo) as SerialNo, -1 AS EnquiryHeaderID, -1 AS EnquiryDetailID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription, STD.TransactionUOMID as ItemUnitID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 ) - ( Select ISNull(SUM(PUR_EnquiryDetail.Quantity), 0) As Quantity From PUR_EnquiryDetail Inner Join PUR_EnquiryRequisition ON PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID INNER JOIN Pur_EnquiryHeader ON Pur_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.StatusCode = 1 Where PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID = Req.DocumentTypeID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentNo = Req.DocumentNo ANd PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 ) --- --IsNull( --( -- Select sum(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity From INV_StockTransactionDetail -- Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID -- And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' -- where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = @StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = Req.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = Req.DocumentNo -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --), 0) AS Quantity, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (STD.[TransactionQuantity]), 0) AS TotalAmount, Req.DocumentNo as ReqNo, Req.DocumentTypeID as ReqTypeID, STD.StockTransactionID, STD.TransactionDetailID, 'Add' AS Action, Convert(smallint, STD.SerialNo) as RowUniqueID FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail] STD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader AS Req ON Req.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID AND Req.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND Req.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = STD.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = STD.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = STD.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = STD.ProjectID Inner join Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail on Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.ItemID = STD.ItemID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status = 1 where STD.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and STD.CompanyID = @CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = @PeriodID and STD.Status = 1 {0} --order by STD.SerialNo asc ) as TAB where TAB.Quantity > 0 --and TAB.TransactionDetailID not in ( --select StockDetailID from Pur_EnquiryRequisition where StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID)
and TAB.TransactionDetailID not in (
select ReqTab.StockDetailID from ( select StockDetailID,sum(STD.TransactionQuantity) - ( Select ISNull(SUM(PUR_EnquiryDetail.Quantity), 0) As Quantity From PUR_EnquiryDetail Inner Join PUR_EnquiryRequisition ON PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID INNER JOIN Pur_EnquiryHeader ON Pur_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.StatusCode = 1 Where PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID = Req.DocumentTypeID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentNo = Req.DocumentNo ANd PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 ) as remainQty from Pur_EnquiryRequisition Inner join Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail on Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status = 1
left join [INV_StockTransactionDetail] STD on STD.StockTransactionID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID and STD.TransactionDetailID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID and STD.ItemID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.ItemID and STD.CompanyID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID and STD.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader AS Req ON Req.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID AND Req.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND Req.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID
where Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = @PeriodID group by Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID ,STD.TransactionDetailID ,Req.DocumentTypeID,Req.DocumentNo )ReqTab where ReqTab.remainQty = 0
)
order by TAB.StockTransactionID,TAB.TransactionDetailID asc

data.name: Query_SalesInvoicePartsReport
data.value:
Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate], SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo], SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID], [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName], [AR_SET_Customer].[AddressLine1], [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] as ItemCategoryID, [INV_SET_Category].CategoryName, [INV_Item].ItemID AS ItemCode, [INV_Item].[Description], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NetAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTaxLiable, (INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount * INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax) / 100 as SalesTaxAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity as Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost as BaseAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GrossAmount From INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID
left JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_InvoiceHeader] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[InvoiceHeaderID] = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceType] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] --AND [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentType] LIKE '%Parts without Sales Tax%'
inner JOIN Sal_DispatchHeader ON Sal_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.[Status] = 1

data.name: Query_SelectData_From_StockRequisitionDetail
data.value:
select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,STD.TransactionUOMID, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, STD.TransactionDetailID, STD.IncurredOnID, STD.IsIncurred, IsNull(AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, -1) CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Incrd.Description as IncurredDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, Round(IsNull(( case isnull(INV_Item.DownloadableFlag,0) when 0 then Round(ISNull((select top 1 INV_StockTransactionDetail.NewCost from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID --And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' ,'/Inventory/Transaction/FinishedGoods.aspx') where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID --and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID and NewCost is not null and isnull(NewCost,0) > 0 Order By Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate desc),0),0) else isnull(inv_Item.ListPricePerUnit,0) end ) , 0) * (STD.TransactionQuantity), 0) AS Amount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, ISNULL(STD.Comments, '') as Comments, ISNULL(STD.IsDone, 'false') as IsDone, ISNULL(STD.IsMajor, 'false') as IsMajor, STD.JobID,STD.JobCode, --Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity2, Cast(Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) AS decimal(18, 5)) as TransactionQuantity2,
Cast(Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) AS decimal(18, 5)) as TransactionQuantity,
( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID left join Set_Location on Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID and Set_Location.Isactive = 1 and Set_Location.Status = 1 and Set_Location.IsWareHouse is null where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = STD.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = STD.CompanyId And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND IsNull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode, 0) = 1 ) AS CurrentStock LEFT JOIN [SET_Project] ON [SET_Project].[ProjectID] = STD.[ProjectID] LEFT JOIN AR_Set_Customer on AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Left Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID =INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And SET_Location.Status=1 ---- GIN Quantuity -- left join INV_StockTransactionDetail GIN on GIN.SourceHEaderId = STD.StockTransactionID -- and GIN.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID -- and GIN.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GINHdr on GINHdr.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID -- left JOIN Set_DocumentType GinDoc ON GinDoc.DocumentTypeID = GINHdr.DocumentTypeID -- AND GinDoc.CompanyID = GINHdr.CompanyID AND GinDoc.PeriodID = GINHdr.PeriodID -- AND GinDoc.Status = 1 -- left Join ApplicationMenu GinMenu On GinMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID -- And GinMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' -- and GINHdr.DocumentTypeID = GinDoc.DocumentTypeID

INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) as Quantity, STD.JobCode,STD.jobID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DemandType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.SeasonType INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = select t.* from ( Select * from ( Select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled] , SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID , INV_SET_Category.CategoryName , INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID , INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription , ISNULL(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, UOM.UOMName) AS UOMName , --SET_Location.LocationName, ISNULL(SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName) AS LocationName , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate , SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) TransactionQuantity , AVG(ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) TransactionCost ,
AVG(ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) AS UnitPrice ,
SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost))) AS Amount , --SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID WHEN 1 THEN 'Positive' WHEN 2 THEN 'Negative' END ELSE SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact END AS TransactionImpact , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode , ISNULL(( CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode THEN 1 WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode THEN ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode THEN ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) END ), 1) UnitQuantity , CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate AS DATE) CreateDate , ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange, 0) AS ValueChange , INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.* , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID , SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo FROM SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) AS DeliveryHeaderDetail ON DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] AND DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] AND DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID AND DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ( ( SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment' ) OR ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) ) WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND ( INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory OR @ItemCategory IS NULL ) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) -- And INV_Item.ItemId = 18 {0} --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null)
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID
) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb {2}) as t
order by t.stocktransactionid

left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode

data.name: Query_Stock_Ledger_FIFO
data.value:
select * from ( SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, case when SET_Location.LocationName is not null then SET_Location.LocationName else locationDt.LocationName end as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.OldItemPrice, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) AS Amount, --SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then case [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact End As TransactionImpact FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) And (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode is Null) --Order By INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate ) AS TAB where TAB.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' Order By TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.CreateDate
--------------------------------------------------
SELECT Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) AS OpeningBalanceQty, AVG(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID

SELECT tab.itemid, tab.Item, 0.0000 as Amount, 0.0000 as Quantity, '' as UOMName, 0.0000 As TransactionCost, tab.GroupName FROM ( select INV_Item.itemid, '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description as Item, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 'GRN' AS DOCTYPE ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName from INV_StockTransactionHeader LEFT join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 LEFT join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
and INV_Item.status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
LEFT join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.menuID where ApplicationMenu.MenuPath like '%/Stock_frm.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Todate {0} group by INV_Item.itemid, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName

LEFT join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID where
[ApplicationMenu].MenuPath like '%/StockReturn.aspx' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Todate {0} group by INV_Item.itemid, INV_Item.Description ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ) as tab

SELECT SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty)OpeningBalanceQty,SUM(t.Amount)/(CASE WHEN SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty) END ) OpeningBalanceRate,t.itemid into #TempItemID FROM ( SELECT Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End) AS OpeningBalanceQty, (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END) AS OpeningBalanceRate,
(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) * (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END)) Amount,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode is Null) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND (isnull(locationDt.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ) t GROUP BY t.itemid

-------------------------------------------------- SELECT SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty)OpeningBalanceQty,SUM(t.Amount)/(CASE WHEN SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty) END ) OpeningBalanceRate,t.itemid FROM ( SELECT Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End) AS OpeningBalanceQty, (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END) AS OpeningBalanceRate,
(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) * (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END)) Amount,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode is Null) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND (isnull(locationDt.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ) t GROUP BY t.itemid

data.name: Query_GetComparativeStatment
data.value:
Select DENSE_RANK() OVER(Order By ItemName) as RowNo , CategoryName,ItemName, openingQty, SUM(TotalQty) as TotalQty,SUM(AdditionalQty) as AdditionalQty,SUM(ConsumedQty) as ConsumedQty, DocDate as DocumentDate from ( Select DATENAME(MONTH, DocumentDate) as Months ,DATENAME(Year,DocumentDate) as Years,CategoryName,DocumentDate as DocDate, Description as ItemName
,Isnull(( Select SUM(GRNDetail.TransactionQuantity) as OpeningQty from INV_StockTransactionHeader OPENGRNHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=OPENGRNHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=OPENGRNHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=OPENGRNHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath='/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' ) INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail GRNDetail On GRNDetail.StockTransactionID=OPENGRNHeader.StockTransactionID AND GRNDetail.PeriodID=OPENGRNHeader.PeriodID AND GRNDetail.CompanyID=OPENGRNHeader.CompanyID AND GRNDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=GRNDetail.ItemID --AND GRNDetail.CompanyID=INV_Item.CompanyID Left jOIn INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID=INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID=INV_Item.CompanyID Where OPENGRNHeader.Status=1 AND OPENGRNHeader.StatusCode=1 AND OPENGRNHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND OPENGRNHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' --AND OPENGRNHeader.DocumentDate @FromDate AND INV_Item.ItemID =fintab.ItemID AND INV_Item.ItemTypeID =fintab.CategoryID ),0) as openingQty, SUM(TotalQty) as TotalQty,SUM(AdditionalQty) as AdditionalQty,SUM(ConsumedQty) as ConsumedQty
from (Select GRNHeader.StockTransactionID ,GRNHeader.DocumentTypeID ,GRNHeader.DocumentDate as DocumentDate , GRNHeader.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.Description ,(GRNDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TotalQty,(GRNDetail.TransactionQuantity) as AdditionalQty ,0 as ConsumedQty from INV_StockTransactionHeader GRNHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=GRNHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=GRNHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=GRNHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath='/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' ) INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail GRNDetail On GRNDetail.StockTransactionID=GRNHeader.StockTransactionID AND GRNDetail.PeriodID=GRNHeader.PeriodID AND GRNDetail.CompanyID=GRNHeader.CompanyID AND GRNDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=GRNDetail.ItemID --AND GRNDetail.CompanyID=INV_Item.CompanyID Left jOIn INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID=INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID=INV_Item.CompanyID Where
GRNHeader.Status=1 AND GRNHeader.StatusCode=1 AND GRNHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND GRNHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND GRNHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0} AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%opening%' UNION All
Select GINHeader.StockTransactionID ,GINHeader.DocumentTypeID, GINHeader.DocumentDate , --,CONVERT(CHAR(4),GINHeader.DocumentDate,100) + CONVERT(CHAR(4), GINHeader.DocumentDate,120), GINHeader.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.Description ,GINDetail.TransactionQuantity as TotalQty ,0 as AdditionalQty,Isnull(GINDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)*-1 as ConsumedQty from INV_StockTransactionHeader GINHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=GINHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=GINHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=GINHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath='/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' ) INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail GINDetail On GINDetail.StockTransactionID=GINHeader.StockTransactionID AND GINDetail.PeriodID=GINHeader.PeriodID AND GINDetail.CompanyID=GINHeader.CompanyID AND GINDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=GINDetail.ItemID --AND GINDetail.CompanyID=INV_Item.CompanyID Left jOIn INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID=INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID=INV_Item.CompanyID Where GINHeader.Status=1 AND GINHeader.StatusCode=1 AND GINHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND GINHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND GINHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0}
) as fintab
Group by DocumentDate,Description,CategoryName,fintab.ItemID,fintab.CategoryID ) tab GROUP by CategoryName,ItemName,openingQty,DocDate Order by DocDate

SELECT -1 [TransactionDetailID], -1 [SerialNo], INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Comments as Remarks, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName as CategoryName, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID], Item.[Description] as [ItemDescription], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID], Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PrimaryQuantity]) AS TransactionQuantity2, Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS TransactionQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PrimaryQuantity], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ReasonLookup], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[DistributionAccountCOA], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[EncumbranceAccountCOA], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[EncumbranceAmount], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[OldItemPrice], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[EstimatedPOItemPrice], ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CurrencyID], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CurrencyConversionRate], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CurrencyConversionType], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[QuantityAdjusted], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[WayBillAirBill], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[FreightCode], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[NoofContainers], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ValueChange], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PercentageChange], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ProjectID], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ReservationLookup], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CostCenterID], Item.[Description], [ItemIncurred].[Description] as IncurredDescription, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].IncurredOnID , [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [SET_Currency].[CurrencyName], [SET_CostCenter].[CostCenterName], [SET_Project].[ProjectName], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[InvoiceFlag], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PriorCost], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID], [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerID, [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerName, ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity], 0) AS Amount, ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) As CurrentStock,
(Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative'
Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) )LastConsumption,
( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, 'Add' [Action] FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail] INNER JOIN [INV_Item] Item ON Item.[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] --AND Item.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] Left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] on [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SupplierID --and [AR_SET_Customer].CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and [AR_SET_Customer].PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON (Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID) --and (Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID) LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Currency] ON [SET_Currency].[CurrencyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CurrencyID] LEFT JOIN [SET_CostCenter] ON [SET_CostCenter].[CostCenterID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CostCenterID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Project] ON [SET_Project].[ProjectID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ProjectID] Left JOIN [INV_Item] ItemIncurred ON ItemIncurred.[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].IncurredOnID AND ItemIncurred.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID]
where [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = @StockTransactionID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 order by [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SerialNo] asc

data.name: Query_SalesTaxInvoicePartsReport
data.value:
Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchDate] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[DispatchNo] ,SAL_DispatchHeader.[CustomerID] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[AddressLine1] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[NTNNumber] ,[AR_SET_Customer].[STRNNumber] ,[INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] as ItemCategoryID ,[INV_SET_Category].CategoryName ,[INV_Item].ItemID AS ItemCode ,[INV_Item].[Description], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax , INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount , INV_StockTransactionDetail.NetAmount , INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsInclusive , INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTaxLiable, --INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID as OrderID --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID as OrderDetailID (INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount * INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax) / 100 as SalesTaxAmount --,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity as ItemUnitQuantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity as Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as BaseAmount ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GrossAmount
From INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = INV_StockTransactionDetail.[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID
left JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SAL_InvoiceHeader] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[InvoiceHeaderID] = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceType] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] --AND [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentType] LIKE '%Parts with Sales Tax%'
inner JOIN Sal_DispatchHeader ON Sal_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
inner join [AR_SET_Customer] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CustomerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [AR_SET_Customer].[Status] = 1
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.[Status] = 1

data.name: Qyery_SelectData_From_StockTransferOutDetail
data.value:
Select INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_Set_Category.CategoryID, INV_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Item.[Description], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] as TransactionUOMID, [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) As CurrentStock, abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1) - isnull((select abs(isnull(sum(TransactionQuantity),0)) from INV_StockTransactionDetail trfOut where trfOut.SourceHeaderID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and trfOut.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and trfOut.SourceCode = INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and trfOut.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID and trfOut.SourceLineID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and trfOut.Status = 1 ),0) as TransactionQuantity, abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity*-1) AS BaseQuantity, INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, (INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID as SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID as SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO AS SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, 'Add' as Action, INV_stockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID, INV_stockTransactionHeader.LocationID AS FromLocationID, INV_stockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID,INV_stockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo, INV_stockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID, IncurredItem.Description AS IncurredItem, INV_stockTransactionHeader.Comments , INV_stockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity ,INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
,abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1) - isnull((select abs(isnull(sum(TransactionQuantity),0)) from INV_StockTransactionDetail trfOut where trfOut.SourceHeaderID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and trfOut.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and trfOut.SourceCode = INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and trfOut.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID and trfOut.SourceLineID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and trfOut.Status = 1 ),0) as ActualQty From INV_stockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_stockTransactionDetail ON INV_stockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Item.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Set_Category ON INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_Set_Category.CompanyID = Item.CompanyID LEFT JOIN INV_Item AS IncurredItem ON IncurredItem.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID --AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = IncurredItem.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = INV_stockTransactionDetail.[TransactionUOMID] WHERE INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID

data.name: Query_getdatewiseledger
data.value:
--GRN And Transfer In SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_Item.Description, SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) TransactionQuantityIn, 0 as TransactionQuantityOut, INV_Item.ItemID, Set_Location.LocationName, CASE WHEN Ar_Set_Customer.CustomerName is null THEN TargetLocation.LocationName ELSE Ar_Set_Customer.CustomerName END AS CustomerName ,SET_Department.DepartmentName From INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- Alhaj Case New Docunment type No impact on Item and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType <> 'Services Note' INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- LEFT JOIN Set_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN Inv_StockTransactionHeader AS SourceStock ON SourceStock.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SourceStock.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SourceStock.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SourceStock.Status = 1 AND SourceStock.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_Location AS TargetLocation ON TargetLocation.LocationID = SourceStock.LocationID LEFT JOIN AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/TransferIn_frm.aspx') LEft JOIN SET_Department ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID=SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1 LEFT JOIN Set_CostCenter SCC ON SCC.CostCenterID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CostCenterID LEFT JOIN Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {1} AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID Or @ItemID Is NULL) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID Is NULL) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} Group BY SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, Set_Location.LocationName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, TargetLocation.LocationName ,SET_Department.DepartmentName UNION ALL --Dispatch, Stock Return And Transfer Out
SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_Item.Description, 0 TransactionQuantityIn, SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) TransactionQuantityOut, INV_Item.ItemID, Set_Location.LocationName, CASE WHEN Ar_Set_Customer.CustomerName is null THEN TargetLocation.LocationName ELSE Ar_Set_Customer.CustomerName END AS CustomerName ,SET_Department.DepartmentName From INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- LEFT JOIN Set_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN Set_Location AS TargetLocation ON TargetLocation.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID LEFT JOIN AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/Sales/VehicleSales/Dispatch_frm.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/TransferOut_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx') LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID=SET_Department.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1 LEFT JOIN Set_CostCenter SCC ON SCC.CostCenterID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CostCenterID LEFT JOIN Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {1} AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID Or @ItemID Is NULL) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID Is NULL) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} Group BY SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, Set_Location.LocationName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, TargetLocation.LocationName,SET_Department.DepartmentName
order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate asc
-------------------------------------------------- 2nd Table --Opening Balances SELECT ABS(SUM ( CASE SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact WHEN 'No Impact' THEN ( CASE WHEN Set_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE 'Transfer In%' THEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ELSE INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * -1 END ) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End )) AS OpeningBalanceQty, AVG(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Inv_Item.Description FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Inv_Item ON --Inv_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID Left JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/TransferIn_frm.aspx', '/Sales/Dispatch_frm.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx', '/Inventory/Transaction/TransferOut_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx')
LEFT JOIN Set_CostCenter SCC ON SCC.CostCenterID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CostCenterID LEFT JOIN Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 {1} AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID Or @ItemID Is NULL) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID Is NULL) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
{0} GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Inv_Item.Description

data.name: Query_GoodsReceiveNote
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo,AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo as RequisitionNo, INV_GrossWeight.GrossWeightID,INV_GrossWeight.NetWeight, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo DCNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate DC_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as PONo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as GRNDate, [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].ChallanNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].InwardGatePass, [SET_Location].[LocationName], [INV_Item].[Description] as [Description], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ActualReceivedQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, --[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], ([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost] - (([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost] * isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer,1)) / 100)) as TransactionCost, --[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], ( [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount] - (([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount] * isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer,1)) / 100)) as Amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus ,abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].RejectedQuantity) as RejectedQuantity ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus, Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreateDate from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreateDate) else '' end as ApproveDate
--(case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then isnull (INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) else null end) as ApproveDate
,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then substring(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0,charindex('-',SET_DocumentType.DocumentType)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) + '-K' when null then substring(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0,charindex('-',SET_DocumentType.DocumentType)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1) + substring(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0,charindex('-',SET_DocumentType.DocumentType)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) end ) as GRNNumber ,(case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue is null then [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue else [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue end) as PreparedBy
,Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy
,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CostCenterID, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DepartmentID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].InwardGatePass,
Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as DocumentType, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks as DetailRemarks, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BiltyNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BiltyDate, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].VehicleNo
,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + s.SourceCode FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail s where s.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and s.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and s.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS PONO)PONumbers, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument AS PackSize ,(
select top 1 UserName from ( select top 2 aspnet_Users.UserName ,Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID from SET_DocumentApprove inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.CompanyID = SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID inner join aspnet_Users on aspnet_Users.UserId = Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID where SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID order by Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID desc )as tab order by DocumentApproveID
) as HOD,
Case POH.DemandType When 1 Then 'BMR' When 2 Then 'Repair Maintenance' When 3 Then 'General' When 4 Then 'Agri Related' Else null End As DemandType
,Case POH.SeasonType When 1 Then 'Season' When 2 Then 'Off-Season' Else null End As SeasonType
,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + Case AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DemandType When 1 Then 'BMR' When 2 Then 'Repair Maintenance' When 3 Then 'General' When 4 Then 'Agri Related' Else null End
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail stockDetail
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and stockDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and stockDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and stockDetail.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and stockDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode
where stockDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and stockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS PONO)Demands
,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + Case AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SeasonType When 1 Then 'Season' When 2 Then 'Off-Season' Else null End
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail stockDetail
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and stockDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and stockDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and stockDetail.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and stockDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode
where stockDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and stockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS PONO)Seasons ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID ,POH.NoteToVendor ,(Select top 1 Specs from PUR_QuotationHeader inner join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID = PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID and PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID and PUR_QuotationDetail.FiscalID = PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID
inner join PUR_EnquiryDetail on PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.FiscalID = PUR_QuotationDetail.FiscalID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID
where PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = POH.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = POH.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo = POH.VendorQuoteNumber AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = POH.FromHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID = POH.FiscalID )Specs FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader POH on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = POH.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = POH.DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = POH.TypeCode
left join INV_GrossWeight on INV_GrossWeight.GrossWeightID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].GrossWeightID and INV_GrossWeight.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID and INV_GrossWeight.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID and INV_GrossWeight.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID and INV_GrossWeight.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item POItem ON --POItem.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And POItem.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID Inner Join INV_SET_Category POCategory On (POCategory.CategoryID = POItem.ItemTypeID) --AND POCategory.CompanyID = POItem.CompanyID
inner JOin SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID=[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1
inner JOin SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID --and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumenttypeID
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%Stock_frm.aspx%') and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Status = 1
