data.name: Query_GetDataByKeyForTransferout
data.value:
SELECT std1.[TransactionDetailID] ,std1.[SerialNo] ,std1.[ItemID] ,Item.[Description] ,std1.[TransactionUOMID] ,[SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName] ,Abs(std1.[TransactionQuantity]) AS ReturnedQuantity --,ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost ,ABS(std1.TransactionCost) as TransactionCost ,std1.[Amount] ,std1.[SourceHeaderID] ,std1.[SourceLineID] ,std1.[SourceCode] ,sth1.DocumentTypeID ,0 as LocationStock ,0 as AlreadyReturnedQuantity ,'' [Action] ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName as CategoryName ,std1.[TransactionQuantity] ,(select abs(IsNull(SUM(((std2.TransactionQuantity *-1) - ISNULL(ReversedQuantity,0)) ),0)) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail std2 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader sth2 On (sth2.StockTransactionID = std2.StockTransactionID) AND sth2.CompanyID = std2.CompanyID And std2.PeriodID = sth2.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On ( SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth2.DocumentTypeID) And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth2.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth2.PeriodID
where std2.ItemID = std1.ItemID ) As CurrentStock , std1.JobID,Set_Job.jobCode ,'' as RackName , null as RackID FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail] std1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] Item ON Item.[ItemID] = std1.[ItemID] --AND Item.[CompanyID] = std1.[CompanyID] LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON (Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID) --and (Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID) LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = std1.[TransactionUOMID]
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth1 on sth1.StockTransactionID = std1. StockTransactionID AND std1.CompanyID = sth1.CompanyID AND std1.PeriodID = sth1.PeriodID
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID = std1.JobID AND Set_Job.CompanyID = std1.CompanyID AND Set_Job.PeriodID = std1.PeriodID AND Set_Job.Status = 1 where std1.[StockTransactionID] = @StockTransactionID and std1.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and std1.[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and std1.[Status] = 1
group by
std1.[TransactionDetailID] ,std1.[SerialNo] ,std1.[ItemID] ,Item.[Description] ,std1.[TransactionUOMID] ,[SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName] ,Abs(std1.[TransactionQuantity]) ,Abs(std1.TransactionCost) --,ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) ,std1.[Amount] ,std1.[SourceHeaderID] ,std1.[SourceLineID] ,std1.[SourceCode] ,sth1.DocumentTypeID ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,std1.[TransactionQuantity],std1.JobID,Set_Job.jobCode
order by [std1].[SerialNo] asc

INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%Stock_frm.aspx%')

data.value:
select INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.TotalAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,Set_Department.DepartmentName,INV_Item.Description from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID inner Join Set_Department on Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
inner join INV_Item on --INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID --And INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.periodid = @PeriodID And (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID = @DepartmentID OR @DepartmentID IS NULL) And (INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID = @CostCenterID Or @CostCenterID is null) AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as Date) Between @FromDate AND @ToDate

data.name: Query_SelectData_From_StockRequisitionDetailForFA
data.value: SELECT INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.[Description] as ItemDescription, STD.TransactionUOMID, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, STD.TransactionDetailID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (STD.TransactionQuantity), 0) AS Amount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, ISNULL(STD.Comments, '') as Comments, ISNULL(STD.IsDone, 'false') as IsDone, Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity2, Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) as TransactionQuantity, STD.SupplierID as CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, '-1' as IsIncurred, '' as IncurredDescription FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail STD on STD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and STD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID Inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Requisition%' LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = STD.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = STD.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = STD.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = STD.ProjectID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = STD.SupplierID Where STD.Status = 1 ANd STD.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd STD.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = @DocumentNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1

data.name: Query_PRN_Costing
data.value: Select max(TAB.DebitAmount) / SUM(TAB.Quantity) from ( Select ( SELECT sum(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = @TransactionType AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID like @CodeCombination ) AS DebitAmount, sum(STD.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, ISNULL((Case when STD.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when STD.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when STD.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity from INV_StockTransactionHeader STH inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail STD on STD.StockTransactionID = STH.StockTransactionID and STD.CompanyID = STH.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = STH.PeriodID and STD.Status = 1 and STD.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode where STH.DocumentTypeID in ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID FROM SET_DocumentType where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = @PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] in (SELECT [ApplicationMenu].[MenuID] FROM [ApplicationMenu] where [ApplicationMenu].[MenuPath] = @MenuPath )) and STH.DocumentDate <= @ToDate and STH.CompanyID = @CompanyID and STH.PeriodID = @PeriodID and STH.[Status] = 1 and STH.IsActive = 1 AND STH.StatusCode = 1 group by STD.TransactionUOMID,INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitVolume,INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight ) as TAB

data.value: SELECT INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.[Description] as ItemDescription, STD.TransactionUOMID, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, STD.TransactionDetailID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (STD.TransactionQuantity), 0) AS Amount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, ISNULL(STD.[Comments], '') as Comments, ISNULL(STD.[IsDone], 'false') as IsDone, Abs(STD.[TransactionQuantity]) as TransactionQuantity2, Abs(STD.[TransactionQuantity]) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) as TransactionQuantity, STD.IsIncurred, STD.IncurredOnID, [FA_AssetIdentity].[ItemName] as IncurredDescription, '-1' as CustomerID, '' as CustomerName FROM [INV_StockTransactionHeader] inner join [INV_StockTransactionDetail] STD on STD.[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] and STD.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] and STD.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = STD.[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = STD.[CompanyID] Inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Requisition%' LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = STD.[TransactionUOMID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Currency] ON [SET_Currency].[CurrencyID] = STD.[CurrencyID] LEFT JOIN [SET_CostCenter] ON [SET_CostCenter].[CostCenterID] = STD.[DepartmentID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Project] ON [SET_Project].[ProjectID] = STD.[ProjectID] LEFT JOIN [FA_AssetIdentity] on [FA_AssetIdentity].AssetIdentityID = [std].IncurredOnID AND [FA_AssetIdentity].[CompanyID] = [std].[CompanyID] AND [FA_AssetIdentity].[PeriodID] = [std].[PeriodID] Where STD.Status = 1 ANd STD.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd STD.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = @DocumentNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1

data.name: Query_FinishedGoodsSearchwithChasis
StockAgeingReportReactiveDyes
data.value:
select TAb.ItemID , TAb.ItemCode , TAb.Item ,TAb.Unit ,SUM(TAB.OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance , SUM(TAB.QtyReceived) as QtyReceived , SUM(TAB.QtyIssued) as QtyIssued,case when abs(SUM(TAB.QtyIssued)) > 0 then max(Days) else 0 end as Days from ( select TAB.ItemID ,TAB.ItemCode ,tab.Item, TAB.Unit, sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty / isnull(TAB.UnitQuantity,1)) as OpeningBalance , 0 as QtyReceived , 0 as QtyIssued,0 as Days from ( SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as Item ,Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity , Inv_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName as Unit FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} -- AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID,INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode ,INV_Item.UnitVolume,INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName
) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Item,TAB.ItemCode , TAB.Unit
Union All
Select INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID , Inv_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode , INV_Item.Description as Item ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName as Unit , 0 as Opening , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as QtyReceived , 0 as QtyIssued,datediff(day, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, @toDate) as Days from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID inner join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx') Left Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0}
Union All
Select INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID , Inv_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode , INV_Item.Description as Item ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName as Unit , 0 as Opening , 0 as QtyReceived ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as QtyIssued,datediff(day, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, @toDate) as Days from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID inner join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.MenuID in (select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx') Left Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1
AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0}
)as TAb
Group By TAb.ItemID , TAb.ItemCode , TAb.Item ,TAb.Unit

data.name: Querey_RecipeWiseBalanceItem
data.value:
with cte as ( Select INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID , INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, sum(abs(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.transactionquantity,0)))transactionquantity from INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' and sourceheaderid is not null group by INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID having sum(abs(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.transactionquantity,0)))>0 ) SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, ISnull(SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,'') as CostCenterName , INV_ITEM.Description as Item,INV_ITEM.InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,SUM(STD.TransactionQuantity) AS TransactionQuantity
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail STD on STD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND STD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND STD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND STD.Status = 1
INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
Left join INV_ITEM on INV_ITEM.ItemID = STD.ItemID
Left Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = std.TransactionUOMID
Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx'
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
left join cte on cte.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID
and cte.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and cte.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and cte.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%PR%' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Store%' {0} GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID,INV_ITEM.Description , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,std.StockTransactionID,STD.TransactionDetailID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,cte.transactionquantity,std.TransactionQuantity ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,INV_ITEM.InventoryItemStatusCode having round(sum(std.TransactionQuantity),2) > round(sum(isnull(cte.transactionquantity,0)),2) order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo asc

data.name: Query_RecipeWsieMaterailIssuance
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID, INV_Item.Description,Set_Location.LocationName
, case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then 'Approved' when 5 then 'InProcess' else '---' end AS StatusCode ,INV_Item.Description ,abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity ,Fabrics_DyeingReceipeIssuanceDetail .Lotno
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location On Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON --INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' inner join Fabrics_DyeingReceipeHeader on Fabrics_DyeingReceipeHeader.RecipeNo = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode inner join Fabrics_DyeingReceipeIssuanceDetail on Fabrics_DyeingReceipeIssuanceDetail.DyeingRecipeID = Fabrics_DyeingReceipeHeader.DyeingRecipeID WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode > 0 {0}

data.name: Query_StockFIFO_Summary
data.value:
select NULL AS isCancelled,NULL AS OrderID ,*,(Case when TAB.TransactionImpact='Positive' then 'A' else 'B' end) CustomSort from ( SELECT INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, case when SET_Location.LocationName is not null then SET_Location.LocationName else locationDt.LocationName end as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, --INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate end as TransactionCost, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate end as UnitPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate, --ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) AS Amount, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate end )) AS Amount, --SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then case [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact End As TransactionImpact,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity AS UnitQuantity FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) AND (isnull(locationDt.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode is Null) --Order By INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate ) AS TAB where TAB.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' Order By TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.CreateDate, TAB.SerialNo
-------------------------------------------------- SELECT t.itemDescription, SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty)OpeningBalanceQty,SUM(t.Amount)/(CASE WHEN SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(t.OpeningBalanceQty) END ) OpeningBalanceRate,t.itemid FROM ( SELECT inv_item.DESCRIPTION itemDescription, Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) AS OpeningBalanceQty, (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END) AS OpeningBalanceRate,
(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End) * (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END)) Amount,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN inv_item ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = inv_item.ItemID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode is Null) And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND (isnull(locationDt.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,inv_item.DESCRIPTION ) t GROUP BY t.itemid,itemDescription

data.name: Query_StockLedgerSummaryFIFO
data.value:
select * from ( SELECT t.LocationID, t.LocationName , t.DESCRIPTION AS ItemDescription, t.ItemID,
t.InventoryItemStatusCode, SUM(t.Received)Received , SUM(t.issued)Issued,
(SUM(t.Received)-SUM(t.issued)) as Balance, t.CategoryID, t.CategoryName, 0.00 AS Rate
FROM ( SELECT set_documenttype.DocumentTypeID,set_documenttype.DocumentType, SET_location.LocationName , inv_item.DESCRIPTION , InventoryItemStatusCode , INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid , (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)LocationID , CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS Received , CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS issued, TransactionImpact, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN inv_item ON inv_item.itemid = INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid INNER JOIN set_documenttype ON set_documenttype.documenttypeid = INV_StockTransactionHeader.documenttypeid AND TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' INNER JOIN SET_location ON SET_location.LocationId = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {1} ) t
WHERE (t.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) AND ( t.LocationID = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (t.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null)
GROUP BY t.LocationID, t.LocationName ,
t.DESCRIPTION, t.itemid,
t.InventoryItemStatusCode, t.CategoryID, t.CategoryName
)as TAB
{0} ORDER BY 8

data.name: Query_StockLedgerDocumentWise
data.value:
select * from (
SELECT t.LocationID, t.LocationName , t.DESCRIPTION AS ItemDescription, t.ItemID,
t.InventoryItemStatusCode, SUM(t.Received)Received , SUM(t.issued)Issued,
(SUM(t.Received)-SUM(t.issued)) as Balance, t.CategoryID, t.CategoryName, 0.00 AS Rate ,t.DocumentType
FROM ( SELECT -1 as DocumentTypeID,'Opening' as DocumentType, SET_location.LocationName , inv_item.DESCRIPTION , InventoryItemStatusCode , INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid , (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)LocationID , CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS Received , CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS issued, TransactionImpact, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN inv_item ON inv_item.itemid = INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid INNER JOIN set_documenttype ON set_documenttype.documenttypeid = INV_StockTransactionHeader.documenttypeid AND TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' INNER JOIN SET_location ON SET_location.LocationId = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate {1} ) t
WHERE (t.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) AND ( t.LocationID = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (t.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null)
GROUP BY t.LocationID,t.LocationName ,t.DESCRIPTION,t.itemid,t.InventoryItemStatusCode,t.CategoryID,t.CategoryName,t.DocumentType UNION ALL SELECT t.LocationID, t.LocationName , t.DESCRIPTION AS ItemDescription, t.ItemID,
t.InventoryItemStatusCode, SUM(t.Received)Received , SUM(t.issued)Issued,
(SUM(t.Received)-SUM(t.issued)) as Balance, t.CategoryID, t.CategoryName, 0.00 AS Rate ,t.DocumentType
FROM ( SELECT set_documenttype.DocumentTypeID,set_documenttype.DocumentType, SET_location.LocationName , inv_item.DESCRIPTION , InventoryItemStatusCode , INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid , (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)LocationID , CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS Received , CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(TransactionQuantity) ELSE 0 END AS issued, TransactionImpact, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN inv_item ON inv_item.itemid = INV_StockTransactionDetail.itemid INNER JOIN set_documenttype ON set_documenttype.documenttypeid = INV_StockTransactionHeader.documenttypeid AND TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' INNER JOIN SET_location ON SET_location.LocationId = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {1} ) t
WHERE (t.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL) AND ( t.LocationID = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) And (t.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null)

inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )

[SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_Batch ON Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_OrderDetail.BatchId --and Set_Batch.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 left join set_location on set_location.LocationID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[LocationID] left join set_rack on set_rack.rackID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[RackID] inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID] = @DispatchID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 ORDER BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchID]

,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,SET_Rack.RackName , null as BatchId , '' as Batch ,null as ColorID,'' as ColorName, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as ItemUnitQuantity , Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity , Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as Rate , 0 as BaseAmount , INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount as GrossAmount,NetAmount ,Convert(bit,0) as IsSalesTaxExempted, null SalesTaxAmount ,Convert(bit,0) as IsExciseDutyExempted, null ExciseDutyAmount ,Convert(bit,0) as IsFEDExempted, null FEDAmount , null SalesTaxAmountA ,ItemCatalogID as CatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,Item.UnitWeight, null as IssuedQty,null as FinishCatalogID , '' as FinishCatalogName , null as FinishCategoryID, '' as FinishCategoryName,null as FinishItemID , '' as FinishItemDescription , null as ExpectedQuantity,null as Wastage,null as DifferenceInPcs, null as ActualQuantity,Convert(bit,0) as Inclusive ,null as DOQty,null as BalanceQty,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID,Fabrics_PackType.PackType,INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoOfPackages
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 Left JOIN Fabrics_PackType On Fabrics_PackType.PackTypeID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID AND Fabrics_PackType.Status=1 left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 order by INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID asc

data.name: Query_GRNReport
data.value:
Select distinct [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].StockTransactionID,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentDate,DocumentNo ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID,DocumentType ,POH.DocumentNumber as PoNO ,POH.DocumentDate as PODate ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].LocationID ,LocationName as ToLocation ,SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,INV_Set_category.CategoryID,CategoryName,INV_ITem.Description as Item ,InventoryItemStatusCode,UnitWeight,Length,Width ,AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity as POQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Quantity ,UOMName ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].Comments as Remarks ,(COnvert(varchar(6),Convert(decimal(18,0),Length)) + ' x '+ConverT(varchar(6),Convert(decimal(18,0),Width))) as Dimension
from INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
inner join INV_ItemDetails on INV_ItemDetails.ItemID = [INV_Item].ItemID
left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
inner JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
left JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader POH on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = POH.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = POH.DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = POH.TypeCode and POH.TypeCode not in (Select DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType where MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%/ALImdad/Transaction/DocumentIN_frm.aspx%' ))
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = 1 AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = 1 and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 and [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate and [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%/ALImdad/Transaction/DocumentIN_frm.aspx%')
{0}

data.name: Query_SelectData_From_StockRequisitionDetailFIFO
data.value:
select * from ( SELECT INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,STD.TransactionUOMID, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, STD.TransactionDetailID, STD.IncurredOnID, STD.IsIncurred, IsNull(AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, -1) CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, '' as IncurredDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, Round(IsNull( ( case isnull(INV_Item.DownloadableFlag,0) when 0 then (select top 1 INV_StockTransactionDetail.NewCost from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID Inner Join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (select DocumentTypeID from Set_DocumentType where DocumentType like '%GIN%')
--Inner Join ApplicationMenu On ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and --INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID and NewCost is not null Order By Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate desc) else isnull(inv_Item.ListPricePerUnit,0) end ) , 0) * (STD.TransactionQuantity), 0) AS Amount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, ISNULL(STD.Comments, '') as Comments, ISNULL(STD.IsDone, 'false') as IsDone, --Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity2, Cast(Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) AS decimal(18, 5)) as TransactionQuantity2,
Cast(Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) AS decimal(18, 5)) as TransactionQuantity,
0 AS CurrentStock ,isnull(INV_Item.DownloadableFlag,0) as DownloadableFlag ,STD.CostCenterID,[SET_CostCenter].CostCenterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID as HeaderCCID ,CC.CostCenterName as HeaderCCName FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail STD on STD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and STD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID Inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Requisition%' LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = STD.[TransactionUOMID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Currency] ON [SET_Currency].[CurrencyID] = STD.[CurrencyID] LEFT JOIN [SET_CostCenter] ON [SET_CostCenter].[CostCenterID] = STD.CostCenterID Left JOIN [SET_CostCenter] CC on CC.CostCenterID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
LEFT JOIN [SET_Project] ON [SET_Project].[ProjectID] = STD.[ProjectID] LEFT JOIN AR_Set_Customer on AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
Where STD.Status = 1 ANd STD.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd STD.PeriodID = @PeriodID
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0}
) as tab where tab.TransactionQuantity2 > 0

Inv_StockTransactionDetail.transactioncost =0 then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END) Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsDone, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) + Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) ) LastConsumption, ( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID as DocumentTypeID, Item.Description as IncurredDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsIncurred, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks, Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName as Location, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate is not null then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) TransactionCost , isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate is not null then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) as CustomAmount, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.NoImpactQty ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,SET_Rack.RackName FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID -- and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 order by INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID asc

---DISPATCH COST OF GOOD SOLD QUERY UPDATE LEDGER Declare @fiscalid int =7; select * from ( select gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId, StockAmount,gl_transactiondetail.CodeCombinationID from (
select INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID, INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,sum(abs(transactionquantity) * averagerate)StockAmount,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID ,CodeCombinationID from INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL INNER JOIN INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER ON INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.STOCKTRANSACTIONID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL.STOCKTRANSACTIONID and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.Status = 1 and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID = @fiscalid INNER JOIN SET_DOCUMENTTYPE ON SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentTypeID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID inner join inv_item on inv_item.itemid =INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL.itemid and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 WHERE SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentType LIKE '%DISPATCH%' and SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DOCUMENTTYPE not LIKE '%DISPATCH%retur%' group by INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID,CodeCombinationID
)t inner join gl_transactionheader on gl_transactionheader.DocumentTypeID = t.DocumentTypeID and gl_transactionheader.DocumentNo = t.DocumentNo and gl_transactionheader.FiscalID = t.FiscalID and gl_transactionheader.documentdate >='2017-01-01'
inner join gl_transactiondetail on gl_transactiondetail.transactionid = gl_transactionheader.transactionid and t.CodeCombinationID = gl_transactiondetail.CodeCombinationID
where gl_transactiondetail.transactionid in (
select gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId from ( select INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID, INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,sum(abs(transactionquantity) * averagerate)StockAmount,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID from INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL INNER JOIN INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER ON INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.STOCKTRANSACTIONID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL.STOCKTRANSACTIONID and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.Status = 1 and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID = @fiscalid INNER JOIN SET_DOCUMENTTYPE ON SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentTypeID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 WHERE SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentType LIKE '%DISPATCH%' and SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DOCUMENTTYPE not LIKE '%DISPATCH%retur%' group by INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID )t inner join gl_transactionheader on gl_transactionheader.DocumentTypeID = t.DocumentTypeID and gl_transactionheader.DocumentNo = t.DocumentNo and gl_transactionheader.FiscalID = t.FiscalID and gl_transactionheader.documentdate >='2017-01-01' inner join gl_transactiondetail on gl_transactiondetail.transactionid = gl_transactionheader.transactionid group by gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId having count(gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId)>2) and gl_transactiondetail.codecombinationid in ('5-01-01-01-01-0005', '5-01-01-01-01-0010', '5-01-01-01-02-0005', '1-02-01-01-01-0005', '1-02-01-01-02-0005', '1-02-01-01-03-0005')
union all
select gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId, StockAmount,gl_transactiondetail.CodeCombinationID from (
select INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID, INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,sum(abs(transactionquantity) * averagerate)StockAmount,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID ,CostOfSalesAccountCCID from INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL INNER JOIN INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER ON INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.STOCKTRANSACTIONID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL.STOCKTRANSACTIONID and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.Status = 1 and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DOCUMENTTYPE ON SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentTypeID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID inner join inv_item on inv_item.itemid =INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL.itemid and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 WHERE SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentType LIKE '%DISPATCH%' and SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DOCUMENTTYPE not LIKE '%DISPATCH%retur%' group by INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID,CostOfSalesAccountCCID )t inner join gl_transactionheader on gl_transactionheader.DocumentTypeID = t.DocumentTypeID and gl_transactionheader.DocumentNo = t.DocumentNo and gl_transactionheader.FiscalID = t.FiscalID and gl_transactionheader.documentdate >='2017-01-01'
inner join gl_transactiondetail on gl_transactiondetail.transactionid = gl_transactionheader.transactionid and t.CostOfSalesAccountCCID = gl_transactiondetail.CodeCombinationID
where gl_transactiondetail.transactionid in (
select gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId from ( select INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID, INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,sum(abs(transactionquantity) * averagerate)StockAmount,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID from INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL INNER JOIN INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER ON INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.STOCKTRANSACTIONID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONDETAIL.STOCKTRANSACTIONID and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.Status = 1 and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DOCUMENTTYPE ON SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentTypeID = INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID and INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.StatusCode = 1 WHERE SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DocumentType LIKE '%DISPATCH%' and SET_DOCUMENTTYPE.DOCUMENTTYPE not LIKE '%DISPATCH%retur%' group by INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentTypeID,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.DocumentNo,INV_STOCKTRANSACTIONHEADER.FiscalID )t inner join gl_transactionheader on gl_transactionheader.DocumentTypeID = t.DocumentTypeID and gl_transactionheader.DocumentNo = t.DocumentNo and gl_transactionheader.FiscalID = t.FiscalID and gl_transactionheader.documentdate >='2017-01-01' inner join gl_transactiondetail on gl_transactiondetail.transactionid = gl_transactionheader.transactionid group by gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId having count(gl_transactiondetail.TransactionId)>2) and gl_transactiondetail.codecombinationid in ('5-01-01-01-01-0005', '5-01-01-01-01-0010', '5-01-01-01-02-0005', '1-02-01-01-01-0005', '1-02-01-01-02-0005', '1-02-01-01-03-0005')
) t --where t.transactionid =8075 order by t.transactionid
