data.name: Query_Select_StockTransferOut_Lookup_AlImdad
data.value:
Select Distinct INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType ,ISNULL(TRansferIN.TransactionQuantity,0) from INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_stockTransactionDetail ON INV_stockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentType Like '%Goods Outward%' or Set_DocumentType.DocumentType Like '%Transfer Out%' or Set_DocumentType.DocumentType Like '%Transfer-Out%') LEFT JOIN ( Select Sum(abs(TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 group by SourceCode,SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceHeaderID,SourceLineID) TRansferIN ON TRansferIN.SourceHeaderID=INV_stockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND TRansferIN.SourceLineID=INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AND TRansferIN.SourceCode=INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND TRansferIN.SourceDocumentTypeID=INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
AND (abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)- ISNULL(TRansferIN.TransactionQuantity,0)) > 0

data.name: Query_StockReq_AssignmentDetails
Query_StockRequistionReport
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT [INV_Item].[ShelfReference],SerialNo,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo as RequisitionNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo DCNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate DC_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as PONo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as GRNDate, [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [SET_Location].[LocationName], [INV_Item].[Description] as [Description], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode] as [ItemStatusCode], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog, CostCenterHead.CostCenterName as HeadingCC, Set_Job.JobDescription as JobCode,
ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus ,abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].RejectedQuantity) as RejectedQuantity ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus,
----(case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then isnull (INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate , ---- INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) else '' end) as ApproveDate
Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreateDate from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdateDate,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreateDate)) else '' end as ApproveDate
,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) when null then 'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) end ) as GRNNumber ,SET_CostCenter .CostCenterName ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,DtlCosCenter .CostCenterName as CostCenter ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, isnull(([INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) as PreParedBy ,Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy,
Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 OR [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=13 then ( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID and Set_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID and Set_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus = 'PartiallyApproved' And SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedBy <> [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedBy order by DocumentApproveID asc) Else isnull(([INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) End as FirstPartialApproved,
Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 OR [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=13 then ( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID and Set_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID and Set_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus = 'PartiallyApproved' order by DocumentApproveID desc) Else isnull(([INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) End as SecondPartialApproved,
isnull((select sum(isnull(TransactionQuantity,0)) * -1 from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = (select Top (1) FiscalID from SET_PeriodCustom where CompanyID = @CompanyID and StartDate < @FromDate order by FiscalId desc)
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath ='/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' )
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = 4 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 ),0) as LastConsumption,
( select sum(SumOfQuantityInStock ) from ( select --IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock case when StkDetail.ImpactID is not null then case StkDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end As SumOfQuantityInStock
from INV_StockTransactionDetail StkDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader StkHdr On StkHdr.StockTransactionID = StkDetail.StockTransactionID AND StkHdr.CompanyID = StkDetail.CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StkHdr.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StkHdr.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = StkHdr.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [StkDetail].LocationID
where StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And StkHdr.Status = 1 --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID is null) AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND StkDetail.IsActive = 1 AND StkHdr.StatusCode = 1 AND StkHdr.ReversalID IS NULL group by StkDetail.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,StkHdr.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType )as tab ) As CurrentStock
,Case [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DemandType When 1 Then 'BMR' When 2 Then 'Repair Maintenance' When 3 Then 'General' When 4 Then 'Agri Related' Else '' End As DemandType
,Case [INV_StockTransactionHeader].SeasonType When 1 Then 'Season' When 2 Then 'Off-Season' Else '' End As SeasonType ,INV_Incurred.Description as IncurredOn
FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND SET_ItemCatalog.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID
left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
Left Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID AND Set_Job.CompanyID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID
inner join SET_CostCenter DtlCosCenter on DtlCosCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID left join SET_CostCenter CostCenterHead on CostCenterHead.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.HeadingCostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.[Status] = 1
left join INV_Item INV_Incurred on INV_Incurred.ITemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] in (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx%')

isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = where Set_RackItems.ItemID = Item.ItemID and SET_Rack.Status = 1) as RackID ,(Select top 1 SET_Rack.RackName from Set_RackItems left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID=Set_RackItems.RackID where Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID

With Cte as ( Select FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID, FinishGoodHeader.PeriodID,FinishGoodHeader.FiscalID, SUM(FinishGoodDetail.TransactionQuantity) as CurrentPro , 0 as PreviousPro from INV_StockTransactionHeader FinishGoodHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail FinishGoodDetail ON FinishGoodDetail.StockTransactionID= FinishGoodHeader.StockTransactionID AND FinishGoodDetail.CompanyID=FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID AND FinishGoodDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= FinishGoodHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 AND DocumentType like '%Finish%Sugar%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = FinishGoodHeader.PeriodID AND SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId=FinishGoodHeader.FiscalID AND SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID= FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID AND @AsOnDate >=SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate >= @AsOnDate
Where FinishGoodHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND FinishGoodHeader.Status=1 AND FinishGoodHeader.DocumentDate <=@AsOnDate and FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID group by FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID, FinishGoodHeader.PeriodID,FinishGoodHeader.FiscalID
UNION ALL
Select FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID, FinishGoodHeader.PeriodID,FinishGoodHeader.FiscalID, 0 as CurrentPro,SUM(FinishGoodDetail.TransactionQuantity) as PreviousPro from INV_StockTransactionHeader FinishGoodHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail FinishGoodDetail ON FinishGoodDetail.StockTransactionID= FinishGoodHeader.StockTransactionID AND FinishGoodDetail.CompanyID=FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID AND FinishGoodDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= FinishGoodHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 AND DocumentType like '%Finish%Sugar%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = FinishGoodHeader.PeriodID AND SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId=FinishGoodHeader.FiscalID AND SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID= FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID AND DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) >=SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate >= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate)
Where FinishGoodHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND FinishGoodHeader.Status=1 AND FinishGoodHeader.DocumentDate <= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) AND StatusCode=1 and FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID group by FinishGoodHeader.CompanyID, FinishGoodHeader.PeriodID,FinishGoodHeader.FiscalID ) -- Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte;
---------------------------Cte----------- Select 'Current' as Section,@AsOnDate as CurrentFiscal, '' as DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,UOM.UOMName ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)*-1) as Quantity,Avg(INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as AvgRate ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity*-1)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as Amount ,(Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 as Production --, SUM(abs(INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost)/(Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte )*0.05 as PertonCost ,CASE WHEN (Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 >0 then SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity*-1)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost)/(Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 else 0 end PertonCost from INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_Header
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_Detail ON INV_Detail.StockTransactionID= INV_Header.StockTransactionID AND INV_Detail.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID AND INV_Detail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID= INV_Detail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID= INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_Header.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID --AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1-- AND DocumentType like '%GIN%' and [SET_DocumentType].menuID in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')) and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom p on p.PeriodID = INV_Header.PeriodID AND P.FiscalId=INV_Header.FiscalID AND P.CompanyID= INV_Header.CompanyID AND @AsOnDate >=P.StartDate AND p.EndDate >=@AsOnDate Where INV_Header.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_Header.Status=1 AND INV_Header.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and INV_Header.CompanyID in @CompanyID {0} group by SET_ItemCatalog.Description,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description,UOM.UOMName ,INV_Header.CompanyID ,INV_Header.FiscalID
UNION ALL
Select 'Previous' as Section,DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) as PreviousFiscal,'' as DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,UOM.UOMName ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)*-1) as Quantity,Avg(INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as AvgRate ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity*-1)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as Amount ,(Select SUM(PreviousPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 as Production ,CASE WHEN (Select SUM(PreviousPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 >0 then SUM(abs(INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost)/(Select SUM(PreviousPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 else 0 end CurPerTonCost from INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_Header
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_Detail ON INV_Detail.StockTransactionID= INV_Header.StockTransactionID AND INV_Detail.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID AND INV_Detail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID= INV_Detail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID= INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_Header.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID --AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1-- AND DocumentType like '%GIN%' and [SET_DocumentType].menuID in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')) and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom p on p.PeriodID = INV_Header.PeriodID AND P.FiscalId=INV_Header.FiscalID AND P.CompanyID= INV_Header.CompanyID AND DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) >=P.StartDate AND p.EndDate >= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) Where INV_Header.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_Header.Status=1 AND INV_Header.DocumentDate <= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) and INV_Header.CompanyID in @CompanyID {0} group by SET_ItemCatalog.Description,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description,UOM.UOMName,INV_Header.CompanyID,INV_Header.FiscalID
union all ---------------- VARIANCE Select 'Variance' as Section,'2000-01-01' as CurrentFiscal,'' as DocumentType,fintab.ItemCatalog,fintab.ItemID ,fintab.ItemName,fintab.UOMName ,SUM(isnull(fintab.preQty,0)-fintab.Quantity) as Quantity,Avg(fintab.AvgRate) as AvgRate ,SUM(fintab.CurrentAmount - fintab.PersAmount) as Amount ,(Select SUM(CurrentPro-PreviousPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID ) *0.05 as Production ,SUM(CurPerTonCost-PrevPerTonCost) as PertonCost from ( Select 'Current' as Section,'2020-09-30' as CurrentFiscal,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,UOM.UOMName ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)) as Quantity,0 as preQty,Avg(INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as AvgRate ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity) *-1 *INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as CurrentAmount ,0 as PersAmount
,CASE WHEN (Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID)*0.05 >0 then SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity*-1)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost)/(Select SUM(CurrentPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID)*0.05 else 0 end as CurPerTonCost ,0 as PrevPerTonCost ,INV_Header.CompanyID,INV_Header.FiscalID from INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_Header
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_Detail ON INV_Detail.StockTransactionID= INV_Header.StockTransactionID AND INV_Detail.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID AND INV_Detail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID= INV_Detail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID= INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_Header.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID --AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1-- AND DocumentType like '%GIN%' and [SET_DocumentType].menuID in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')) and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom p on p.PeriodID = INV_Header.PeriodID AND P.FiscalId=INV_Header.FiscalID AND P.CompanyID= INV_Header.CompanyID AND @AsOnDate >=P.StartDate AND p.EndDate >=@AsOnDate --- finish Good -------- Where INV_Header.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_Header.Status=1 AND INV_Header.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and INV_Header.CompanyID in @CompanyID {0} group by SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.Description,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description,UOM.UOMName ,INV_Header.CompanyID,INV_Header.FiscalID
UNION ALL
Select 'Previous' as Section,DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) as PreviousFiscal,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,UOM.UOMName ,0 as Quantity,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)) as preQty,Avg(INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as AvgRate ,0 as CurrentAmount ,SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 *INV_Detail.TransactionCost) as PersAmount ,0 as CurPerTonCost ,CASE WHEN (Select SUM(PreviousPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 >0 then SUM((INV_Detail.TransactionQuantity*-1)*INV_Detail.TransactionCost)/(Select SUM(PreviousPro) from Cte where Cte.CompanyID = INV_Header.CompanyID and Cte.FiscalID = INV_Header.FiscalID )*0.05 else 0 end PrevPerTonCost ,INV_Header.CompanyID,INV_Header.FiscalID from INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_Header
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_Detail ON INV_Detail.StockTransactionID= INV_Header.StockTransactionID AND INV_Detail.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID AND INV_Detail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID= INV_Detail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID= INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_Header.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_Header.CompanyID --AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1-- AND DocumentType like '%GIN%' and [SET_DocumentType].menuID in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')) and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom p on p.PeriodID = INV_Header.PeriodID AND P.FiscalId=INV_Header.FiscalID AND P.CompanyID= INV_Header.CompanyID AND DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) >=P.StartDate AND p.EndDate >= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) --- finish Good -------- --- Where INV_Header.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_Header.Status=1 AND INV_Header.DocumentDate <= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) and INV_Header.CompanyID in @CompanyID
{0} group by SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.Description,INV_Item.ItemID ,INV_Item.Description,UOM.UOMName ,INV_Header.CompanyID,INV_Header.FiscalID ) as fintab
group by fintab.ItemCatalog,fintab.ItemID ,fintab.ItemName,fintab.UOMName,CompanyID

data.name: Closing_Query_Stock_Ledger
data.value:
Select * from (Select FinTAb.CatalogName, FinTAb.ShelfReference, FinTAb.CategoryName, FinTAb.ItemID, FinTAb.ItemDescription, FinTAb.UOMName, --FinTAb.LocationName, --FinTAb.TransactionImpact,
FinTAb.InventoryItemStatusCode, Sum(FinTAb.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity
from ( Select * from ( SELECT Distinct SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName, INV_Item.ShelfReference, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, --0 as TransactionQuantity, (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) as TransactionQuantity, 'opening' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
Inner Join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID=INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY SET_ItemCatalog.Description, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.ShelfReference, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ) as TAB
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName, INV_Item.ShelfReference, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) Inner Join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID=INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY SET_ItemCatalog.Description, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.ShelfReference, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID
) as TAB
) as FinTAb where fintab.TransactionQuantity <> 0 Group By FinTAb.CatalogName, FinTAb.ShelfReference, FinTAb.CategoryName, FinTAb.ItemID, FinTAb.ItemDescription, FinTAb.UOMName, -- Fintab.LocationName, --FinTAb.TransactionImpact, FinTAb.InventoryItemStatusCode ) FinalFinTAb {FilterByQty}

data.name: Query_GetDataForTransferIn_WithStock
data.value:
Select INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_stockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_Set_Category.CategoryID, INV_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID, Item.[Description], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] as TransactionUOMID, [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader as INV_StockTransactionHeader2 On INV_StockTransactionHeader2.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader2.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader2.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader2.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader2.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader2.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' And INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID ) As CurrentStock, (abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)- ISNULL(TRansferIN.TransactionQuantity,0)) as TransactionQuantity, (abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)- ISNULL(TRansferIN.TransactionQuantity,0)) AS Basequantity, (abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)- ISNULL(TRansferIN.TransactionQuantity,0)) AS issuedQty, INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, (INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID as SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID as SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO AS SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, 'Add' as Action, INV_stockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID, INV_stockTransactionHeader.LocationID AS FromLocationID, INV_stockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID,INV_stockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo, INV_stockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID, IncurredItem.Description AS IncurredItem, INV_stockTransactionHeader.Comments , INV_stockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity ,INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID as CatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName,INV_ItemDetails.ProductType,INV_ItemDetails.GoodsType,INV_ItemDetails.ProductStyle ,TransactionCost as Rate,null as POQuantity,null as SupplierDCQuantity,null as ActualReceivedQuantity,null as ShortQuantity, null as RejectedQuantity,null as TaxAmount,null as TaxPercent,null as CustomDuty,null as CustomDutyPercent ,null as OtherCharges, null as OtherChargesPercent,'' as ShipmentNumber,0 as NetAmount,null as AmountINDollar,null as IncomeTaxPercent,null as IncomeTax ,null as FinishCatalogID,'' as FinishCatalogName,null as FinishCategoryID,'' as FinishCategoryName,null as FinishItemID,'' as FinishItemDescription,0 as ExpectedQuantity ,ISnull(ITem.UnitWeight,0)UnitWeight,null as ClearingCharges,'' as ContainerSize,null as FreightCharges,null as RecipeNo,null as CMTRate,null as CMTAmount,'' as InternalContNo,null as TransportationCharges ,null as NoOfPackages , null as PackTypeID ,'' as PackType ,INV_stockTransactionDetail.UOMID , null as UnitofMeasure ,Quantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Bags ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Bags,0) >0 then ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)/ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Bags,0) else INV_ItemDetails.PiecesinCarton end PieceInPakage From INV_stockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_stockTransactionDetail ON INV_stockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_stockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Item.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Set_Category ON INV_Set_Category.CategoryID = Item.ItemTypeID AND INV_Set_Category.CompanyID = Item.CompanyID LEFT JOIN INV_Item AS IncurredItem ON IncurredItem.ItemID = INV_stockTransactionHeader.IncurredOnID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = IncurredItem.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = INV_stockTransactionDetail.[TransactionUOMID] left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID left join INV_ItemDetails on INV_ItemDetails.ItemID = ITem.ItemID LEFT JOIN ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 group by SourceCode,SourceDocumentTypeID,SourceHeaderID,SourceLineID) TRansferIN ON TRansferIN.SourceHeaderID=INV_stockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND TRansferIN.SourceLineID=INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AND TRansferIN.SourceCode=INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND TRansferIN.SourceDocumentTypeID=INV_stockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
WHERE INV_stockTransactionHeader.CompanyID =@PeriodID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @CompanyID AND INV_stockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID AND (abs(INV_stockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)- ISNULL(TRansferIN.TransactionQuantity,0)) > 0

data.name: Query_GetStopagesDetail
data.value:
SELECT cast(Stopagesdetail.FromTime as Time) as FromTime,cast(Stopagesdetail.ToTime as Time) as ToTime, cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) as TotalTime, Stoppages_ReasonDetail.Reason as Reason,Stopagesdetail.StopagesDetailID as StoppagesDetailID, Stopagesdetail.* , StoppagesAndReason.StoppageName , Stopagesdetail.KWH ,(select DATEDIFF(hour, TimeIn, TimeOut) from HRMS_SET_Shift where ShiftID = Stopagesdetail.ShiftID) ShiftDuration --,DATEPART(HOUR,Stopagesdetail.TotalTime)+DATEPART(HOUR,Stopagesdetail.TotalTime)/60 [StopageHrs] ,(select DATEDIFF(hour, TimeIn, TimeOut) from HRMS_SET_Shift where ShiftID = Stopagesdetail.ShiftID) - (DATEPART(HOUR,Stopagesdetail.TotalTime)+DATEPART(HOUR,Stopagesdetail.TotalTime)/60) [ProductionHrs] ,'Update' as [Action],SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName
FROM Stopagesdetail
inner join StoppagesAndReason on StoppagesAndReason.StoppageID = Stopagesdetail.StoppageID and StoppagesAndReason.Status = 1
inner join Stoppages_ReasonDetail on Stoppages_ReasonDetail.StoppageID = StoppagesAndReason.StoppageID and Stoppages_ReasonDetail.stoppagesdetailid = Stopagesdetail.reason and Stoppages_ReasonDetail.status = 1
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = Stopagesdetail.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = Stopagesdetail.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
where Stopagesdetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and Stopagesdetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Stopagesdetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Stopagesdetail.Status = 1
{0} order by Stopagesdetail.StopagesDetailID asc
data.comment:
SELECT cast(Stopagesdetail.FromTime as Time) as FromTime,cast(Stopagesdetail.ToTime as Time) as ToTime, cast(Stopagesdetail.TotalTime as Time) as TotalTime, Stoppages_ReasonDetail.Reason as Reason,Stopagesdetail.StopagesDetailID as StoppagesDetailID, Stopagesdetail.* , StoppagesAndReason.StoppageName ,'Update' as [Action],SET_Department.DepartmentName,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName FROM Stopagesdetail
inner join StoppagesAndReason on StoppagesAndReason.StoppageID = Stopagesdetail.StoppageID and StoppagesAndReason.Status = 1
inner join Stoppages_ReasonDetail on Stoppages_ReasonDetail.StoppageID = StoppagesAndReason.StoppageID and Stoppages_ReasonDetail.stoppagesdetailid = Stopagesdetail.reason and Stoppages_ReasonDetail.status = 1
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = Stopagesdetail.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1 left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = Stopagesdetail.CostCenterID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
where Stopagesdetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and Stopagesdetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Stopagesdetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Stopagesdetail.Status = 1 {0} order by Stopagesdetail.StopagesDetailID asc

data.name: Query_shiftDetail
data.value:
SELECT 'Update' as [Action],* FROM EmployeeDetail
inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.stocktransactionid = EmployeeDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = EmployeeDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = EmployeeDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID = EmployeeDetail.PersonID inner join SET_Designation on SET_Designation.DesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID left join HRMS_Set_Shift on HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = EmployeeDetail.ShiftID where EmployeeDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and EmployeeDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and EmployeeDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and EmployeeDetail.Status = 1 {0} order by EmployeeDetail.EmployeeDetailID asc

data.name: Query_COnsumptionWithQuantity
data.value:
select abs( sum (tab.Quantity) ) as amount,tab.MonthYear,tab.Item ,MAX( cast( tab.documentdate as date )) as DocumentDate ,CAST( datepart (month ,MIN( tab.documentdate)) +''+ datepart (year ,MIN( tab.documentdate)) as int) DateMonth ,CategoryID,Category,Catalog,ItemCatalogGroupID as CatalogID from ( select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item --,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as amount ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,cast( datename(month, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as varchar(3)) +'-'+ cast( datename(year, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as varchar(4)) as MonthYear ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName --,sum( ISNULL( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 0)) * sum( ISNULL( INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity ,0) ) as NewAmount ,case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs((INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS NewAmount ,case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS Quantity ,CategoryID,CategoryName as Category,ItemCatalogGroupID ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as Catalog from dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact' and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join Set_CostCenter on Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID where [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (64, 12, 114,28,114, 114,28) --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @Todate --and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID = @LocationID
{0}
) tab
group by tab.MonthYear ,tab.Item,CategoryID,Category,Catalog,ItemCatalogGroupID order by min ( cast(tab.documentdate as date)) asc

data.name: Query_GeneratorConsumptionSummary
data.value: select format(ConsumptionDate,'MMM yy') as ConsumptionDate,sum(Hours) as Hours,sum(FuelLtr) as FuelLtr,sum(Amount) as Amount from Set_GeneratorsConsumption where CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(ConsumptionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by format(ConsumptionDate,'MMM yy')

data.name: Query_GeneratorConsumption
data.value: select format(ConsumptionDate,'MMM yy') as ConsumptionDate,sum(Hours) as Hours,sum(FuelLtr) as FuelLtr,sum(Amount) as FuelCost,sum(isnull(RepiarCost,0)) as RepiarCost ,(sum(Amount) + sum(isnull(RepiarCost,0))) as TotalCost ,((sum(Amount) + sum(isnull(RepiarCost,0)))/sum(Hours)) as PerHourCost ,inv_item.Description from Set_GeneratorsConsumption inner join inv_Item on inv_Item.itemid = Set_GeneratorsConsumption.itemID and inv_Item.status = 1 where Set_GeneratorsConsumption.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_GeneratorsConsumption.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(ConsumptionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by format(ConsumptionDate,'MMM yy'),inv_item.Description

data.name: Query_GeneratorDetail
data.value: select distinct inv_item.Description from Set_GeneratorsConsumption inner join inv_Item on inv_Item.itemid = Set_GeneratorsConsumption.itemID and inv_Item.status = 1 where Set_GeneratorsConsumption.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_GeneratorsConsumption.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(ConsumptionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate

data.name: Query_ElectricityConsumption
data.value: select format(ElectricityConsumptionDate,'MMM yy') as ConsumptionDate,sum(NoOfUnits) as Units,sum(NetAmount) as NetAmount,sum(GSTAmount) as GST, sum(AdvTaxAmount) as AdvTax, (sum(NetAmount)+ sum(isnull(GSTAmount,0)) + sum(isnull(AdvTaxAmount,0))) as TotalBill, (SET_Location.LocationName + ' (Meter No ' + MeterNO + ')') as MeterNO from SET_ElectricityConsumption inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = SET_ElectricityConsumption.LocationID and SET_Location.status = 1 where SET_ElectricityConsumption.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_ElectricityConsumption.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(ElectricityConsumptionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by format(ElectricityConsumptionDate,'MMM yy'),MeterNO,LocationName

data.name: Query_ElectricityConsumptionDetail
data.value:
select Sum(tab.NetAmount) As ElectricityExpense ,sum(tab.DutyAmount) as DutyAmount ,sum(tab.AlounitsToEmploye) as AlounitsToEmploye ,(sum(tab.NetAmount) + sum(isnull(DutyAmount,0)) + sum(isnull(AlounitsToEmploye,0))) as TotalElectricityExpense ,sum(convert(int,tab.Claimable)) as SalesTaxInputClaimed, sum(tab.AdvTaxAmount) as AdvTaxAmount ,tab.OperatingUnitName, tab.Period From ( Select NetAmount, DutyAmount, AlounitsToEmploye, Claimable, AdvTaxAmount ,(SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from SET_ElectricityConsumption
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SET_ElectricityConsumption.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_ElectricityConsumption].ElectricityConsumptionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_ElectricityConsumption.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_ElectricityConsumption.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(ElectricityConsumptionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by OperatingUnitName ,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,NetAmount,DutyAmount,AlounitsToEmploye,Claimable,AdvTaxAmount )tab Group By tab.OperatingUnitName, tab.Period
-- for unit
select sum(tab.NoOfUnits) as NoOfUnits ,tab.LocationName as LocationName ,tab.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,tab.Period as Period From ( Select NoOfUnits ,SET_Location.LocationName, (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from SET_ElectricityConsumption
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_ElectricityConsumption .CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = SET_ElectricityConsumption.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = SET_ElectricityConsumption .LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_ElectricityConsumption].ElectricityConsumptionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_ElectricityConsumption.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_ElectricityConsumption.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(ElectricityConsumptionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by OperatingUnitName ,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,LocationName,NoOfUnits )tab Group By tab.LocationName, tab.OperatingUnitName, tab.Period

data.name: Query_MessExpenses
data.value:
select format(MessTransactionDate,'MMM yy') as MessTransactionDate,MessTypeName,sum(Amount) as Amount ,format(MessTransactionDate,'yy') as MessTransactionDate1,format(MessTransactionDate,'MM') as MessTransactionDate2 ,Set_MessTransaction.locationName from Set_MessTransaction
where Set_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate {0} --group by format(MessTransactionDate,'MMM yy'),format(MessTransactionDate,'yy'),format(MessTransactionDate,'MM'),MessTypeName --order by format(MessTransactionDate,'yy'),format(MessTransactionDate,'MM') group by format(MessTransactionDate,'yy'),format(MessTransactionDate,'MM'),format(MessTransactionDate,'MMM yy'),MessTypeName,Set_MessTransaction.locationName order by format(MessTransactionDate,'yy'),format(MessTransactionDate,'MM')

data.name: Query_Stock_Ledger2
data.value:
select @FromDate as FromDate,@TODate as AsOnDate,CodeCombinationID,AccountCodeDescription,CategoryName,Description as ItemDescription,ItemID,InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo,UOMName,ListPricePerUnit
,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount,sum(TransferINQty) as TransferINQty,sum(TransferINAmount) as TransferINAmount, sum(StockReturnTransferQty) as StockReturnTransferQty,sum(StockReturnTransferAmount) as StockReturnTransferAmount, sum(TransferQty) as TransferQty,sum(TransferAmount) as TransferAmount --,sum(GINQty) as GINQty,sum(GIN_Amount) as GIN_Amount
from (
Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as AccountCodeDescription, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,
INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,
SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit,
(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else
case when TransactionImpact = 'Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1
when TransactionImpact = 'Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End) as OpeningQty,
(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End)* std.TransactionCost --(case when std.TransactionQuantity > 0 then std.TransactionCost else ISNULL(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost) -- END) as OpeningAmount,
0 AS TransferINQty, 0 AS TransferINAmount,
0 as StockReturnTransferQty, 0 as StockReturnTransferAmount, 0 AS TransferQty, 0 AS TransferAmount,
sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,sth .DocumentNo From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1 Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID
Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID WHERE sth.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate < @FromDate and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) --and SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (64, 12, 114,28,114, 114,28) {0} {1}
union all
Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as AccountCodeDescription, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,
INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,
SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit,
0 as OpeningQty, 0 as OpeningAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Stock%Return%' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferINQty, case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Stock%Return%' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferINAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock%Return%' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS StockReturnTransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock%Return%' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS StockReturnTransferAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferAmount,
sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,sth .DocumentNo From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1
Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID
Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID
WHERE sth.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) --and SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (64, 12, 114,28,114, 114,28) {0} {1} )as tab group by CodeCombinationID,AccountCodeDescription,CategoryName,Description,ItemID,InventoryItemStatusCode,UOMName,ListPricePerUnit

data.name: Query_LimeSlaker
data.value:
select Set_BankFacility.BankName,LimitName,sum(Set_BankFacility.Amount) as LimitAmount, --sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) as available1, (select sum(isnull(AP_PaymentBanksDetailinner.Amount,0)) from AP_PaymentBanksDetail AP_PaymentBanksDetailinner inner join AR_SET_BankBranch AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner on AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetailinner.BankBranchID inner join AR_SET_Bank AR_SET_Bankinner on AR_SET_Bankinner.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner.BankID where AR_SET_Bankinner.BankID = Set_BankFacility.BankID ) + (select sum(isnull(AR_ReceiptBanksDetailinner.Amount,0)) from AR_ReceiptBanksDetail AR_ReceiptBanksDetailinner inner join AR_SET_BankBranch AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner on AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptBanksDetailinner.BankBranchID inner join AR_SET_Bank AR_SET_Bankinner on AR_SET_Bankinner.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner.BankID where AR_SET_Bankinner.BankID = Set_BankFacility.BankID ) as available
,(case when funded =1 then 'Funded' else 'Non Funded' end) as FundedNonFunded from Set_BankFacility --inner join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = Set_BankFacility.BankID --and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 --inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID --inner join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
where Set_BankFacility.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_BankFacility.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_BankFacility.IsActive = 1 and format(StartDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by Set_BankFacility.BankName,LimitName,Set_BankFacility.BankID,funded order by FundedNonFunded

data.name: Query_MessExpensesSummary
data.value:
Select SUM(tab.SiteAmount) as SiteAmount ,SUM(tab.HOAmount) as HOAmount ,SUM(tab.Units) as Units ,tab.OperatingUnitName ,tab.Period ,tab.MessTypeName ,SUM(tab.SiteAmount) + SUM(tab.HOAmount) as Total from ( Select --sum(Amount) as SiteAmount Case When SET_MessTransaction.locationName = 'Site' Then Amount Else 0 End As SiteAmount --,0 as HOAmount ,Case When SET_MessTransaction.locationName = 'Head Office' Then Amount Else 0 End As HOAmount ,sum(NoofMembers) as Units, '' as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period ,MessTypeName from SET_MessTransaction
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_MessTransaction].MessTransactionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,MessTypeName,SET_MessTransaction.locationName,Amount
)tab Group By tab.OperatingUnitName, tab.Period, tab.MessTypeName
-------- For Total and Per Month Expenses ---------- Select SUM(tab.SiteAmount) as SiteAmount ,SUM(tab.HOAmount) as HOAmount ,tab.Units as Units ,tab.OperatingUnitName ,tab.Period ,tab.MessTypeName ,SUM(tab.SiteAmount) + SUM(tab.HOAmount) as Total from ( Select --sum(Amount) as SiteAmount Case When SET_MessTransaction.locationName = 'Site' Then Amount Else 0 End As SiteAmount --,0 as HOAmount ,Case When SET_MessTransaction.locationName = 'Head Office' Then Amount Else 0 End As HOAmount ,'' As Units--sum(NoofMembers) as Units, ,'' as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period , 'Total' As MessTypeName--MessTypeName from SET_MessTransaction
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_MessTransaction].MessTransactionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,MessTypeName,SET_MessTransaction.locationName,Amount
)tab Group By tab.OperatingUnitName, tab.Period, tab.MessTypeName,tab.Units
Union All
Select (SUM(tab.SiteAmount)/12) as SiteAmount ,(SUM(tab.HOAmount)/12) as HOAmount ,tab.Units as Units ,tab.OperatingUnitName ,tab.Period ,tab.MessTypeName ,(SUM(tab.SiteAmount) + SUM(tab.HOAmount)/12) as Total from ( Select --sum(Amount) as SiteAmount Case When SET_MessTransaction.locationName = 'Site' Then Amount Else 0 End As SiteAmount --,0 as HOAmount ,Case When SET_MessTransaction.locationName = 'Head Office' Then Amount Else 0 End As HOAmount ,'' As Units--sum(NoofMembers) as Units, ,'' as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period , 'Per Month Expenses' As MessTypeName--MessTypeName from SET_MessTransaction
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_MessTransaction].MessTransactionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,MessTypeName,SET_MessTransaction.locationName,Amount
)tab Group By tab.OperatingUnitName, tab.Period, tab.MessTypeName,tab.Units
-- for Monthly Approval
select sum(Amount) as SiteAmount, 0 as HOAmount, sum(NoofMembers) as Units, '' as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period ,MessTypeName, 'Per Member' as UnitPerMember, sum(Amount)/sum(NoofMembers) as UnitPerMemberAmount,'' as MessSeasonName,SUM(SubsidyPercentage) As SubsidyPercentage from SET_MessTransaction
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_MessTransaction].MessTransactionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate and MessTypeName not like '%GuestHouse%' and MessTypeName not like '%WorkersMess%' group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,MessTypeName
union all
select sum(0) as SiteAmount, 0 as HOAmount, sum(0) as Units, '' as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period ,MessTypeName, '' as UnitPerMember, 0 as UnitPerMemberAmount ,'' as MessSeasonName, SUM(0) As SubsidyPercentage from SET_MessTransaction
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_MessTransaction].MessTransactionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate and MessTypeName like '%WorkersMess%' group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,MessTypeName
union all
select sum(Amount) as SiteAmount, 0 as HOAmount, sum(NoofMembers) as Units, '' as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period ,MessTypeName, 'Monthly' as UnitPerMember, sum(Amount)/12 as UnitPerMemberAmount,MessSeasonName,SUM(SubsidyPercentage) As SubsidyPercentage from SET_MessTransaction
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SET_MessTransaction].MessTransactionDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SET_MessTransaction.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SET_MessTransaction.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(MessTransactionDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate and MessTypeName like '%WorkersMess%' group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,MessTypeName,MessSeasonName

data.name: Query_BankFacilities
data.value:
select Set_BankFacility.BankName,LimitName,sum(Set_BankFacility.Amount) as LimitAmount--, --sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) as available1, --(select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetailinner.Amount) from AP_PaymentBanksDetail AP_PaymentBanksDetailinner --inner join AR_SET_BankBranch AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner on AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetailinner.BankBranchID --inner join AR_SET_Bank AR_SET_Bankinner on AR_SET_Bankinner.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranchinnerinner.BankID --where AR_SET_Bankinner.BankID = Set_BankFacility.BankID --) as available ,(case when funded =1 then 'Funded' else 'Non Funded' end) as FundedNonFunded
,sum(Set_BankFacility.Amount) - (Select Distinct -- tab.BankBranchID,UPPER(tab.BankBranchName) AS BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, --UPPER( tab.BankAccountNumber) AS BankAccountNumber, ABS(SUM(tab.OpeningBalance)) OpeningBalance From ( Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, 0) OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
--AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = Set_BankFacility.BankID -- AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) and format(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID
AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = Set_BankFacility.AccountNo
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) * -1 OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
-- AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = Set_BankFacility.BankID -- And (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate Or AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) and format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1 --and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID -- AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = Set_BankFacility.AccountNo
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When ReceiptData.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) Else IsNull(ReceiptData.Amount, 0) * -1 End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID =
