AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID From AR_ReceiptBanksDetail Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and format(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 -- AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID -- AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = Set_BankFacility.BankID --AND (AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate Or AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) and format(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
Where AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 ) As ReceiptData On ReceiptData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And ReceiptData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And ReceiptData.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON ReceiptData.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND ReceiptData.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND ReceiptData.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = Set_BankFacility.AccountNo
UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID, AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchName, AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, Case When PaymentData.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) * -1 Else IsNull(PaymentData.Amount, 0) End As OpeningBalance From AR_Set_bankAccount INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankBranch On AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID Left Join ( Select AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID From AP_PaymentBanksDetail Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 --AND (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) Inner Join AR_Set_BankAccount On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_Set_BankAccount.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_Set_BankAccount.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_bankBranch ON AR_Set_bankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID AND AR_Set_bankBranch.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_Set_bankBranch.BankID --AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankID = @BankID AND AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = Set_BankFacility.BankID -- And (AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate Or AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Is Null) and format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
Where AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 ) As PaymentData On PaymentData.PeriodID = AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID And PaymentData.BankAccountID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID And PaymentData.BankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID left JOIN SET_DocumentType ON PaymentData.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND PaymentData.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND PaymentData.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_Set_bankAccount.Status = 1
AND AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = Set_BankFacility.AccountNo )tab Group By tab.BankBranchID, tab.BankBranchName, tab.BankAccountID, tab.BankAccountNumber) as available
from Set_BankFacility --inner join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = Set_BankFacility.BankID --and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 --inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID = AR_SET_Bank.BankID --inner join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
where Set_BankFacility.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_BankFacility.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_BankFacility.IsActive = 1 and Set_BankFacility.Status = 1 and format(StartDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate group by Set_BankFacility.BankName,LimitName,Set_BankFacility.BankID,funded,Set_BankFacility.BankID,Set_BankFacility.AccountNo order by FundedNonFunded

data.name: Query_CaneCarrier
data.value:
select 'Cane carrier cleaning expenses' as Description,'Rupees' as Units,sum(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from GL_TransactionDetail
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%Cane carrier%' inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
union all
select 'Cane crushing' as Description,'M.Tons' as Units,sum(cane_Crushing.CrushingQuantity) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from cane_Crushing
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = cane_Crushing.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = cane_Crushing.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on cane_Crushing.CrushingDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and cane_Crushing.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where cane_Crushing.CompanyID = @CompanyID and cane_Crushing.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(CrushingDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
union all
select 'Per M.ton of crushing' as Description , 'Rupees' as Units, --sum(Amount)/sum(Qty) as Qty_Amount, (case when sum(Qty) > 0 then sum(Amount)/sum(Qty) else 0 end) as Qty_Amount, OperatingUnitName,Period from ( select '' as Description,'' as Units, 0 as Qty, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount as Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from GL_TransactionDetail
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%Cane carrier%' --inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate --group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
union all
select '' as Description,'' as Units,cane_Crushing.CrushingQuantity as Qty, 0 as Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from cane_Crushing
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = cane_Crushing.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = cane_Crushing.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on cane_Crushing.CrushingDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and cane_Crushing.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where cane_Crushing.CompanyID = @CompanyID and cane_Crushing.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(CrushingDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate --group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate )tab group by OperatingUnitName,Period
---------------
select 'Contract Details' as Description,'Rs. PerMonth' as Units,sum(UnLoadingRate) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from Set_CarrrierClean
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_CarrrierClean.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
-----------------
select 'Security Deposit' as Description,'Rs' as Units,sum(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from Set_CarrrierClean
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Set_CarrrierClean.ContractorID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Security_Deposit%' inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status =1 --inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_CarrrierClean.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
union all
select (case when ActivityType = 'Own' then 'Average monthly workers - Own' else 'Average monthly workers - Contractual' end) as Description,'Nos.' as Units,sum(LaboursQty)/12 as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from Set_CarrrierClean
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_CarrrierClean.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by ActivityType,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
---------
select 'Approved by' as Description,'-' as Units, '-' as Qty_Amount, --isnull(Set_CarrrierClean.UpdatedByValue,Set_CarrrierClean.CreatedByValue) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from Set_CarrrierClean
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_CarrrierClean.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,Set_CarrrierClean.UpdatedByValue,Set_CarrrierClean.CreatedByValue

data.name: Query_CaneCarrierDetail
data.value:
select (case when ActivityType = 'Own' then 'Salaries & Wages of own labour' else 'Contractor' end) as Description, sum(UnLoadingRate) as Rate, sum(LaboursQty) as Units, --(sum(UnLoadingRate)*sum(LaboursQty)) as Amount, sum(Set_CarrrierClean.Amount) as Amount, format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'MMM yy') as CDate from Set_CarrrierClean
where Set_CarrrierClean.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_CarrrierClean.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by ActivityType , format(Set_CarrrierClean.CreateDate,'MMM yy')

data.name: Query_CaneUnloadingDetail
data.value:
select (case when ActivityType = 'Own' then 'Salaries & Wages of own labour' else 'Contractor' end) as Description,sum(UnLoadingRate) as Rate, sum(LaboursQty)/100 as Units, (sum(UnLoadingRate)*sum(LaboursQty)) as Amount, format(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'MMM yy') as CDate from Cane_UnloadingContractor
where Cane_UnloadingContractor.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Cane_UnloadingContractor.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by ActivityType , format(Cane_UnloadingContractor.CreateDate,'MMM yy')

data.name: Query_CaneUnloading

select 'Cane unloading expenses' as Description,'Rupees' as Units,sum(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from GL_TransactionDetail
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%Cane unloading%' inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate

select 'Cane crushing' as Description,'Maunds' as Units,sum(cane_Crushing.CrushingQuantity) as Qty_Amount, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from cane_Crushing
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = cane_Crushing.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = cane_Crushing.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on cane_Crushing.CrushingDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and cane_Crushing.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%Cane unloading%' --inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate --group by Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate

data.name: Query_SugarloadingDetail
data.value:
Select 1 as Sorting, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as [Description],0 as Rate, gl_transactionDetail.Amount ,'Per Bag' as Units ,format(gl_transactionheader.DocumentDate,'MMM yy') as CDate from gl_transactionDetail
inner join gl_transactionheader on gl_transactionheader.transactionid = gl_transactionDetail.transactionid and gl_transactionheader.companyid = gl_transactionDetail.companyid and gl_transactionheader.periodid = gl_transactionDetail.periodid and gl_transactionheader.fiscalid = gl_transactionDetail.fiscalid and gl_transactionheader.statuscode = 1
inner join gl_codecombinationdetail on gl_codecombinationdetail.codecombinationid = gl_transactionDetail.codecombinationid --and gl_codecombinationdetail.Description like '%loading%'
where gl_transactionDetail.status = 1 and (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID like '08-01-03-001-%' and LOWER(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description) like '%loading%') and gl_transactionheader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and gl_transactionheader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
and format(gl_transactionheader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by format(gl_transactionheader.DocumentDate,'MMM yy'), GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description,gl_transactionDetail.Amount

data.name: Query_MajorAdditionsSummary
data.value:
select 'Owned Assets' as Description,sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as Amount, (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName ,(format(Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate,'yyyy') + ' - ' + format(SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,'yyy')) as Period from INV_StockTransactionHeader
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GIN%' and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode <> ''
where --INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
group by OperatingUnitName ,Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate

inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%GIN%' and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode <> ''

data.name: Query_BMRDetail

select ItemName,LocationName,sum(Amount) as Amount, SourceType,(SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName from BMR_Budget
inner join BMR_BudgetDetail on BMR_BudgetDetail.BudgetHeaderID = BMR_Budget.BudgetID and BMR_BudgetDetail.CompanyID = BMR_Budget.CompanyID and BMR_BudgetDetail.PeriodID = BMR_Budget.PeriodID and BMR_BudgetDetail.Status = 1

where BMR_Budget.Status = 1 and BMR_Budget.IsActive = 1 --and BMR_Budget.CompanyID = @CompanyID and BMR_Budget.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(BMR_Budget.BudgetDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate group by ItemName,LocationName, SourceType,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName

data.name: Query_BMRSummary
data.value:
select OperatingUnitName, sum(CrushCapicity) as CrushCapicity , sum(Local) as Local , sum(Imported) as Imported, (sum(POLocalAmt) - sum(isnull(POTaxLocal,0))) as POLocalAmt , (sum(POImpAmt) - sum(isnull(POTaxImp,0))) as POImpAmt , sum(POTaxLocal) as POTaxLocal , sum(POTaxImp) as POTaxImp, sum(PaidLocal) as PaidLocal ,sum(PaidImported) as PaidImported from (
select tab.OperatingUnitName, sum(CrushCapicity) as CrushCapicity, sum(tab.Local) as Local , sum(tab.Imported) as Imported ,sum(tab.POLocalAmt) as POLocalAmt , sum(tab.POImpAmt) as POImpAmt , sum(tab.POTaxLocal) as POTaxLocal, sum(tab.POTaxImp) as POTaxImp , sum(0) as PaidLocal, sum(0) as PaidImported from ( select (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName,sum(CrushCapicity) as CrushCapicity, sum(Amount) as Local , 0 as Imported ,sum(0) as POLocalAmt, sum(0) as POImpAmt, sum(0) as POTaxLocal, sum(0) as POTaxImp from BMR_Budget
inner join BMR_BudgetDetail on BMR_BudgetDetail.BudgetHeaderID = BMR_Budget.BudgetID and BMR_BudgetDetail.CompanyID = BMR_Budget.CompanyID and BMR_BudgetDetail.PeriodID = BMR_Budget.PeriodID and BMR_BudgetDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = BMR_Budget.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
where BMR_Budget.Status = 1 and BMR_Budget.IsActive = 1 --and BMR_Budget.CompanyID = @CompanyID and BMR_Budget.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(BMR_Budget.BudgetDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate and SourceType = 'Local' group by SourceType,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName
union all
select (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName,sum(CrushCapicity) as CrushCapicity, 0 as Local ,sum(Amount) as Imported ,sum(0) as POLocalAmt, sum(0) as POImpAmt, sum(0) as POTaxLocal, sum(0) as POTaxImp from BMR_Budget
inner join BMR_BudgetDetail on BMR_BudgetDetail.BudgetHeaderID = BMR_Budget.BudgetID and BMR_BudgetDetail.CompanyID = BMR_Budget.CompanyID and BMR_BudgetDetail.PeriodID = BMR_Budget.PeriodID and BMR_BudgetDetail.Status = 1
--inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = BMR_Budget .CompanyID inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = BMR_Budget.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
where BMR_Budget.Status = 1 and BMR_Budget.IsActive = 1 --and BMR_Budget.CompanyID = @CompanyID and BMR_Budget.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(BMR_Budget.BudgetDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate
and SourceType = 'Imported' group by SourceType,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName )tab

from BMR_Budget

inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType SET_DocumentType2 on SET_DocumentType2.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType2.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType2.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType2.DocumentType like '%import%'
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID and SET_Currency.Status = 1
where FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 --and BMR_Budget.IsActive = 1 and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate --and SourceType = 'Imported'
union all
select distinct (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,INV_Item.Description, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber, (0) as POAmount ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Rate, (AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) as PaidImported from FA_LetterOfCreditHeader
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType SET_DocumentType2 on SET_DocumentType2.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType2.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType2.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType2.DocumentType like '%import%' inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID and SET_Currency.Status = 1 inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Advance against PO%'
where FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate
union all
select distinct (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as OperatingUnitName,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,INV_Item.Description, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber, (0) as POAmount ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.LCNo ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.BankName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName ,FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Rate, (AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) as PaidImported
from FA_LetterOfCreditHeader
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType SET_DocumentType2 on SET_DocumentType2.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType2.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType2.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType2.DocumentType like '%import%' inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join SET_Currency on SET_Currency.CurrencyID = FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.CurrencyID and SET_Currency.Status = 1
inner join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderDetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail on AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status =1 --and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Payment against vendor%' where FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.Status = 1 and FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(FA_LetterOfCreditHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') between @FromDate and @ToDate
)tab group by tab.OperatingUnitName,tab.CustomerName,tab.Description,tab.PONumber,tab.LCNo,tab.BankName,tab.CurrencyName,tab.Rate

data.name: Query_AdvancesToSupplierAging
data.value:
select CustomerCategory,CustomerName,sum(Days30) as Days30,sum(Days60) as Days60 ,sum(Days90) as Days90 , sum(Days120) as Days120,sum(Days180) as Days180 ,sum(Over180Days) as Over180Days, sum(InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount,sum(ActualPOAmount) as ActualPOAmount from ( select Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, --AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, --sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) as Adv , (case when DATEDIFF(Day,(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),cast(GETDATE() as date)) < 30 then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else 0 end) as 'Days30', (case when DATEDIFF(Day,(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),cast(GETDATE() as date)) between 30 and 60 then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else 0 end) as 'Days60', (case when DATEDIFF(Day,(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),cast(GETDATE() as date)) between 61 and 90 then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else 0 end) as 'Days90', (case when DATEDIFF(Day,(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),cast(GETDATE() as date)) between 91 and 120 then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else 0 end) as 'Days120', (case when DATEDIFF(Day,(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),cast(GETDATE() as date)) between 121 and 180 then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else 0 end) as 'Days180', (case when DATEDIFF(Day,(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),cast(GETDATE() as date)) > 180 then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else 0 end) as 'Over180Days',
0 as InvoiceAmount, sum(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount) as ActualPOAmount from AP_PaymentHeader
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and DocumentType like '%Advance against po%'
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Vendor'
inner join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 --where CustomerName = 'CIBRO AGENCIES (PRIVATE) LIMITED'
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
group by Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate --order by DocumentDate
union all
select Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, 0 as Days30, 0 as Days60, 0 as Days90, 0 as Days120, 0 as Days180, 0 as Over180Days, sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) as InvoiceAmount, 0 as ActualPOAmount from AR_InvoiceDetail
inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join ap_purchaseORderHEader on ap_purchaseORderHEader.POHeaderID = Ar_invoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID and ap_purchaseORderHEader.CompanyID = Ar_invoiceDetail.CompanyID and ap_purchaseORderHEader.PeriodID = Ar_invoiceDetail.PeriodID and ap_purchaseORderHEader.Status = 1 and ap_purchaseORderHEader.StatusCode = 1 and ap_purchaseORderHEader.AdvanceAmountPercentage > 0
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'vendor Invoice%'
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Vendor'
inner join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and format(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'yyyy-MM') <= @ToDate and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
group by Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName --,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate --order by DocumentDate )tab group by CustomerCategory,CustomerName having (sum(Days30) > 0 OR sum(Days60) > 0 or sum(Days90) > 0 or sum(Days120) > 0 or sum(Days180) > 0 or sum(Over180Days) > 0)

data.name: Query_PurchaseReturnReport
data.value:
SELECT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, SET_Location.LocationName, INV_Item.Description, [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS Quantity,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost AS UnitPrice, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalDate AS ReturnDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS GRNNo, case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus, isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) as ApprovedBy,
(case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue is null then [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue else [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue end) as PreparedBy
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%PurchaseReturn.aspx%') AND ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) > 0

data.name: Query_Stock_Balance_Quantity_Grainsize

declare @CompanyID int = @CompanyID1, @PeriodID int = @PeriodID1, @FromDate date = @FromDate1, @ToDate date = @ToDate1, @ItemCategory int = @ItemCategory1, @GrainSizeID int = @GrainSizeID1, @PackTypeID int = @PackTypeID1, @LocationID int = @LocationID1
select isnull(SUM(transactionquantity),0) as TransactionQuantity from ( Select TransactionQuantity from ( Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as TransactionQuantity, 0 as TransactionCost, 0 AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount, 'opening' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID = @GrainSizeID Or @GrainSizeID is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID = @PackTypeID Or @PackTypeID is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) -- AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) {0} AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID
) as TAB {1}
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, --SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end as TransactionQuantity, Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END AS UnitPrice, SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) AS Amount, --SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID = @GrainSizeID Or @GrainSizeID is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID = @PackTypeID Or @PackTypeID is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID
) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb {2} ) as t

data.name: Query_BMRDetailReport
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
select finalTab.Description,finalTab.AssetTypeName,finalTab.ItemName,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit1) as QuantityUnit1 ,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit2) as QuantityUnit2,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit1) as AmountUnit1,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit2) as AmountUnit2 from ( select tab.Description,tab.AssetTypeName,tab.ItemName ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit2 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit2 --,tab.Amount from ( select --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, --SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, SET_Business.BusinessName, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Description, FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName, INV_Item.Description as ItemName ,SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as Amount
from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Set_DocumentType.Status = INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoheaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1
inner join FA_SET_AssetType on FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = INV_Item.EquipmentTypeID and FA_SET_AssetType.Status = 1
inner join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobID and Set_Job.JobCode = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode and Set_Job.Status = 1 and Set_Job.CompanyID in @CompanyID
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Set_Job.AccountCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName on GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.RefrenceCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Status = 1
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CapitalExpenseFlag = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode is not null and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobID != 0 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Description, FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName, INV_Item.Description ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName ,SET_Business.BusinessName ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName --,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID )tab )finalTab
group by finalTab.Description,finalTab.AssetTypeName,finalTab.ItemName

--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-02-22 00:00:00:000'
select finalTab.PeriodSetName, finalTab.Description --,finalTab.AssetTypeName --,finalTab.ItemName --,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit1) as QuantityUnit1 --,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit2) as QuantityUnit2 ,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit1) as AmountUnit1,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit2) as AmountUnit2 from ( select tab.PeriodSetName, tab.Description, tab.AssetTypeName,tab.ItemName ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit2 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit2 --,tab.Amount from ( select --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, --SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, SET_Business.BusinessName, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Description, FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName, INV_Item.Description as ItemName ,SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as Quantity, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount) as Amount
from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Set_DocumentType.Status = INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoheaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID
inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1
inner join FA_SET_AssetType on FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeID = INV_Item.EquipmentTypeID and FA_SET_AssetType.Status = 1
inner join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobID and Set_Job.JobCode = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode and Set_Job.Status = 1 and Set_Job.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and Set_Job.CompanyID in (1,2) inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Set_Job.AccountCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName on GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.RefrenceCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Status = 1
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CapitalExpenseFlag = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode is not null and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobID != 0 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1,2) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate
group by GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Description, FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName, INV_Item.Description ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName ,SET_Business.BusinessName ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName --,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID )tab )finalTab
group by finalTab.PeriodSetName, finalTab.Description

inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName on GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.RefrenceCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Status = 1
where INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CapitalExpenseFlag = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobCode is not null and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.JobID != 0 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1,2) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate
group by GL_CodeCombinationDetailHeadName.Description, FA_SET_AssetType.AssetTypeName, INV_Item.Description ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName ,SET_Business.BusinessName ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName --,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID )tab )finalTab
group by finalTab.Description

data.name: Query_LimeSlakerReport
data.value:
--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
select 'Lime Slaker expenses' as Description , SUM((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1 end)) as result ,'Rupees' as units from GL_TransactionDetail left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID
where GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID like '05-01-14-001-%' and LOWER(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description) not like '%loading%') and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
-----------------------------------------
SELECT 'Sugar Production' as Description, SUM(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) * 20 AS result, 'M.Tons' as units
from INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ClearingAgent ON ClearingAgent.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID AND ClearingAgent.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1
Left Join SET_DocumentApprove on SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus='Approved' Left Join HRMS_Set_Shift on HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID and HRMS_Set_Shift.Status=1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
Where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Finish Goods - Sugar' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID ANd INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 group by SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName
-------------------------------------
select distinct sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount from AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join Set_LimeSlaker on Set_LimeSlaker.ContractorID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID and Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and Set_LimeSlaker.Status = 1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID
where GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%security%deposit%' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
----------------------------------------
select SUM(t.OwnLabour) as OwnLabour , SUM(t.ContactLabour) as ContactLabour from ( select case when ActivityType = 'Own' then Sum(OwnLabour) else 0 end as OwnLabour, case when ActivityType = 'Contact' then Sum(OwnLabour) else 0 end as ContactLabour from Set_LimeSlaker
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_LimeSlaker.EffectedFromDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID
where Set_LimeSlaker.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_LimeSlaker.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_LimeSlaker.EffectedFromDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by Set_LimeSlaker.ActivityType )t

data.name: Query_CaneUnloadingExpensesReport

--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
select 'Cane unloading expenses' as Description , SUM((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1 end)) as result ,'Rupees' as units from GL_TransactionDetail left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID
