inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join Cane_UnloadingContractor on Cane_UnloadingContractor.ContractorID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID and Cane_UnloadingContractor.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and Cane_UnloadingContractor.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and Cane_UnloadingContractor.Status = 1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID
where GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%security%deposit%' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_StockRequistionReport_JK
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo as RequisitionNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo DCNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate DC_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as PONo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as GRNDate, [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [SET_Location].[LocationName], [INV_Item].[Description] as [Description], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode] as [ItemStatusCode], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog, CostCenterHead.CostCenterName as HeadingCC, Set_Job.JobDescription as JobCode,
ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus ,abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].RejectedQuantity) as RejectedQuantity ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus,
(case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then isnull (INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) else '' end) as ApproveDate
,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) when null then 'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'GRN' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) end ) as GRNNumber ,SET_CostCenter .CostCenterName ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,DtlCosCenter .CostCenterName as CostCenter ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.Description as DocTypeDescription, isnull(([INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) as PreParedBy ,Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy, ( select sum(SumOfQuantityInStock ) from ( select --IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock case when StkDetail.ImpactID is not null then case StkDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end As SumOfQuantityInStock
from INV_StockTransactionDetail StkDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader StkHdr On StkHdr.StockTransactionID = StkDetail.StockTransactionID AND StkHdr.CompanyID = StkDetail.CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StkHdr.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StkHdr.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = StkHdr.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [StkDetail].LocationID
where StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = 2 And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = 2 And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And StkHdr.Status = 1 --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID is null) --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND StkDetail.IsActive = 1 AND StkHdr.StatusCode = 1 AND StkHdr.ReversalID IS NULL group by StkDetail.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,StkHdr.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType )as tab ) As CurrentStockUnitI
,( select sum(SumOfQuantityInStock ) from ( select --IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock case when StkDetail.ImpactID is not null then case StkDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end As SumOfQuantityInStock
from INV_StockTransactionDetail StkDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader StkHdr On StkHdr.StockTransactionID = StkDetail.StockTransactionID AND StkHdr.CompanyID = StkDetail.CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StkHdr.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StkHdr.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = StkHdr.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [StkDetail].LocationID
where StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = 1 And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = 1 And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And StkHdr.Status = 1 --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID is null) --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND StkDetail.IsActive = 1 AND StkHdr.StatusCode = 1 AND StkHdr.ReversalID IS NULL group by StkDetail.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,StkHdr.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType )as tab ) As CurrentStockUnitII
,Case [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DemandType When 1 Then 'BMR' When 2 Then 'Repair Maintenance' When 3 Then 'General' When 4 Then 'Agri Related' Else null End As DemandType
,Case [INV_StockTransactionHeader].SeasonType When 1 Then 'Season' When 2 Then 'Off-Season' Else null End As SeasonType
,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
left JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND SET_ItemCatalog.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID
left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
Left Join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID AND Set_Job.CompanyID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID
inner join SET_CostCenter DtlCosCenter on DtlCosCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID left join SET_CostCenter CostCenterHead on CostCenterHead.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.HeadingCostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.[Status] = 1
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx%')

data.name: Query_Stock_Balance_Quantity_LocAndRack
data.value:
select isnull(SUM(transactionquantity),0) as TransactionQuantity from ( Select TransactionQuantity from ( Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as TransactionQuantity, 0 as TransactionCost, 0 AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount, 'opening' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) -- AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) {0} AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID
) as TAB {1}
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, --SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end as TransactionQuantity, Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END AS UnitPrice, SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) AS Amount, --SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID
) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb {2} ) as t

select * from ( ----------Budget-------------- select finaltab.ItemID , max(finaltab.CategoryName) as CategoryName,finaltab.ItemDescription,max(finaltab.UOMName) as UOMName,sum(finaltab.RequiredQty) as RequiredQty, sum(finaltab.RevisedQty) as RevisedQty , sum(finaltab.StoreBalance) as StoreBalance, sum(finaltab.Rate) as Rate , sum(finaltab.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount ,sum(finaltab.POQty) as POQty ,sum(finaltab.PORate) as PORate, sum(finaltab.POAmt) as POAmt , sum(finaltab.RemainingQuantity) as RemainingQuantity, @Season as Season from ( select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription,isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, AnnualBudget_Detail.Quantity as RequiredQty , 0 as RevisedQty , 0 as StoreBalance , AnnualBudget_Detail.Rate,AnnualBudget_Detail.GrossAmount , 0 as POQty , 0 as POAmt , 0 as RemainingQuantity , 0 as PORate from AnnualBudget_Detail
inner join AnnualBudget_Header on AnnualBudget_Header.annualBudgetID = AnnualBudget_Detail.annualBudgetID and AnnualBudget_Header.CompanyID = AnnualBudget_Detail.CompanyID and AnnualBudget_Header.periodid = AnnualBudget_Detail.periodid and AnnualBudget_Header.status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = AnnualBudget_Detail.itemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
WHERE AnnualBudget_Detail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AnnualBudget_Detail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AnnualBudget_Detail.Status = 1 and (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) {0} AND convert(date,AnnualBudget_Header.AnnualBudgetDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND AnnualBudget_Header.StatusCode = 1 {1}

-- group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , -- '(' + INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode + ') ' + INV_Item.Description , INV_Item.ItemID,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber , -- INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo , AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity , -- Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity) , -- INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity , -- AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity , INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost , -- round(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 1) , INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount , -- round((AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, 3), -- INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, -- INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, -- CONVERT(varchar(20), AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 105) , AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName -- ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID,AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID -- ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID -- ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments
-- having isnull(( -- select sum(indtl.QuantityInvoiced) -- from AR_InvoiceHeader invHdr -- inner join AR_InvoiceDetail indtl on indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID -- and indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = invHdr.InvoiceID -- and indtl.CompanyID = invHdr.CompanyID -- and indtl.PeriodID = invHdr.PeriodID -- and indtl.Status = 1 and invHdr.StatusCode = 1 -- where indtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID -- and indtl.InvoiceDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID -- and indtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID -- and indtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID -- ),0 ) <> INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity

---------------------Opening------------------------------
select TAB.ItemID,'' as CategoryName , tab.Description as ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as RequiredQty, 0 as RevisedQty , sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as StoreBalance , 0 as Rate , 0 as GrossAmount , 0 as POQty , 0 as POAmt , 0 as RemainingQuantity , 0 as PORate FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID) LocationID ,case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else null end as TransactionCost
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description )finaltab group by finaltab.ItemID ,finaltab.ItemDescription ) fintab where fintab.CategoryName != ''

data.name: Query_Annual_Budget_Summary
data.value:
select * from ( ----------Budget-------------- select finaltab.ItemID , max(finaltab.CategoryName) as CategoryName,finaltab.ItemDescription,max(finaltab.UOMName) as UOMName,sum(finaltab.RequiredQty) as RequiredQty, sum(finaltab.RevisedQty) as RevisedQty , sum(finaltab.StoreBalance) as StoreBalance, sum(finaltab.Rate) as Rate , sum(finaltab.GrossAmount) as GrossAmount ,sum(finaltab.POQty) as POQty ,sum(finaltab.PORate) as PORate, sum(finaltab.POAmt) as POAmt , sum(finaltab.RemainingQuantity) as RemainingQuantity , finaltab.DepartmentID , finaltab.DepartmentName ,finaltab.OperatingUnitName,@Season as Season from ( select INV_Item.ItemID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription,isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, AnnualBudget_Detail.Quantity as RequiredQty , 0 as RevisedQty , 0 as StoreBalance , AnnualBudget_Detail.Rate,AnnualBudget_Detail.GrossAmount , 0 as POQty , 0 as POAmt , 0 as RemainingQuantity , 0 as PORate ,SET_Department.DepartmentID , SET_Department.DepartmentName , OperatingUnitName from AnnualBudget_Detail
inner join AnnualBudget_Header on AnnualBudget_Header.annualBudgetID = AnnualBudget_Detail.annualBudgetID and AnnualBudget_Header.CompanyID = AnnualBudget_Detail.CompanyID and AnnualBudget_Header.periodid = AnnualBudget_Detail.periodid and AnnualBudget_Header.status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = AnnualBudget_Detail.itemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = AnnualBudget_Header.DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode left Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AnnualBudget_Header.CompanyID left Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
WHERE AnnualBudget_Detail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AnnualBudget_Detail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AnnualBudget_Detail.Status = 1 and (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) {0} AND convert(date,AnnualBudget_Header.AnnualBudgetDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND AnnualBudget_Header.StatusCode = 1 {1}
-------------PO----------- union all

---------------------Opening------------------------------
select TAB.ItemID,'' as CategoryName , tab.Description as ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as RequiredQty, 0 as RevisedQty , sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as StoreBalance , 0 as Rate , 0 as GrossAmount , 0 as POQty , 0 as POAmt , 0 as RemainingQuantity , 0 as PORate , 0 as DepartmentID , '' as DepartmentName , '' as OperatingUnitName FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID) LocationID ,case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else null end as TransactionCost
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description )finaltab group by finaltab.ItemID ,finaltab.ItemDescription , finaltab.DepartmentID , finaltab.DepartmentName , finaltab.OperatingUnitName ) fintab where fintab.CategoryName != ''

data.name: Query_GetConsumptionReportData
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate, sum(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) * abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) as Amount, --INV_StockTransactionHeader.TotalAmount as Amount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID,Set_Department.DepartmentName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID, SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCateglog, CONVERT(varchar(3), INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 100) as Months
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (122,167,171,50,122) And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location On Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer Contractor ON Contractor.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ContractorID AND Contractor.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Contractor.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Contractor.Status = 1 INNER jOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status=1 INNER jOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID and SET_ItemCatalog.Status = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
Group By INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID, Set_Department.DepartmentName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID, SET_ItemCatalog.Description, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate

select * from ( SELECT Convert(smallint, '1') as ChkSelect, Convert(smallint, STD.SerialNo) as SerialNo, -1 AS EnquiryHeaderID, -1 AS EnquiryDetailID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription, STD.TransactionUOMID as ItemUnitID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 ) - ( Select ISNull(SUM(PUR_EnquiryDetail.Quantity), 0) As Quantity From PUR_EnquiryDetail Inner Join PUR_EnquiryRequisition ON PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.StatusCode = 1 Where PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID = Req.DocumentTypeID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentNo = Req.DocumentNo ANd PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 ) --- --IsNull( --( -- Select sum(abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) as TransactionQuantity From INV_StockTransactionDetail -- Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID -- And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- And Set_DocumentType.MenuID And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' -- where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = @StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = Req.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = Req.DocumentNo -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --), 0) AS Quantity, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (STD.[TransactionQuantity]), 0) AS TotalAmount, Req.DocumentNo as ReqNo, Req.DocumentTypeID as ReqTypeID, STD.StockTransactionID, STD.TransactionDetailID, 'Add' AS Action, Convert(smallint, STD.SerialNo) as RowUniqueID FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail] STD INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader AS Req ON Req.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID AND Req.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND Req.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = STD.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = STD.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = STD.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = STD.ProjectID --Inner join Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail on Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID -- and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID -- and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.ItemID = STD.ItemID -- and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status = 1 where STD.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and STD.CompanyID = @CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = @PeriodID and STD.Status = 1 {0} --order by STD.SerialNo asc ) as TAB where TAB.Quantity > 0 --and TAB.TransactionDetailID not in ( --select StockDetailID from Pur_EnquiryRequisition where StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID)
and TAB.TransactionDetailID not in (
select ReqTab.StockDetailID from ( select StockDetailID,sum(STD.TransactionQuantity) - ( Select ISNull(SUM(PUR_EnquiryDetail.Quantity), 0) As Quantity From PUR_EnquiryDetail Inner Join PUR_EnquiryRequisition ON PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID INNER JOIN Pur_EnquiryHeader ON Pur_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND Pur_EnquiryHeader.StatusCode = 1 Where PUR_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd PUR_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID = STD.TransactionDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentTypeID = Req.DocumentTypeID and PUR_EnquiryRequisition.DocumentNo = Req.DocumentNo ANd PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 ) as remainQty from Pur_EnquiryRequisition Inner join Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail on Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID = Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID and Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.Status = 1
left join [INV_StockTransactionDetail] STD on STD.StockTransactionID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.StockTransactionID and STD.TransactionDetailID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.TransactionDetailID and STD.ItemID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.ItemID and STD.CompanyID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = Pur_RequisitionAssigmentDetail.PeriodID and STD.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader AS Req ON Req.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID AND Req.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID AND Req.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID
where Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and Pur_EnquiryRequisition.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Pur_EnquiryRequisition.PeriodID = @PeriodID group by Pur_EnquiryRequisition.StockDetailID ,STD.TransactionDetailID ,Req.DocumentTypeID,Req.DocumentNo )ReqTab where ReqTab.remainQty = 0
)
order by TAB.StockTransactionID,TAB.TransactionDetailID asc

data.name: Query_GoodsReceiveNoteHSM
