SELECT DISTINCT [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo,AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo as RequisitionNo, INV_GrossWeight.GrossWeightID,INV_GrossWeight.NetWeight, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanNo DCNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.ChallanDate DC_Date, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as GRNNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as PONo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as GRNDate, [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].ChallanNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].InwardGatePass, [SET_Location].[LocationName], [INV_Item].[Description] as [Description], [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ActualReceivedQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, --[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice, ([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost] - (([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost] * isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer,1)) / 100))) as TransactionCost, --[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], ( [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount] - (([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount] * isnull(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer,1)) / 100)) as Amount, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5),'') as DocumentStatus ,abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].RejectedQuantity) as RejectedQuantity ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus, Case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreateDate from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreateDate) else '' end as ApproveDate
--(case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 1 then isnull (INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdateDate , INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) else null end) as ApproveDate
,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks
--,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then -- substring(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0,charindex('-',SET_DocumentType.DocumentType)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) + '-K' -- when null -- then substring(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0,charindex('-',SET_DocumentType.DocumentType)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) -- else -- SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1) + substring(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0,charindex('-',SET_DocumentType.DocumentType)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) -- end ) as GRNNumber ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo) as GRNNumber ,(case when [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue is null then [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue else [INV_StockTransactionHeader].UpdatedByValue end) as PreparedBy ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CostCenterID, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DepartmentID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].InwardGatePass, isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue) as ApprovedBy, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as DocumentType, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Remarks as DetailRemarks, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BiltyNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BiltyDate, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].VehicleNo
,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + s.SourceCode FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail s where s.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and s.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and s.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS PONO)PONumbers, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument AS PackSize ,(
select top 1 UserName from ( select top 2 aspnet_Users.UserName ,Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID from SET_DocumentApprove inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.CompanyID = SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID inner join aspnet_Users on aspnet_Users.UserId = Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID where SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo and SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].CompanyID order by Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID desc )as tab order by DocumentApproveID
) as HOD,
Case POH.DemandType When 1 Then 'BMR' When 2 Then 'Repair Maintenance' When 3 Then 'General' When 4 Then 'Agri Related' Else null End As DemandType
,Case POH.SeasonType When 1 Then 'Season' When 2 Then 'Off-Season' Else null End As SeasonType
,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + Case AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DemandType When 1 Then 'BMR' When 2 Then 'Repair Maintenance' When 3 Then 'General' When 4 Then 'Agri Related' Else null End
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail stockDetail
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and stockDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and stockDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and stockDetail.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and stockDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode
where stockDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and stockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS PONO)Demands
,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + Case AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.SeasonType When 1 Then 'Season' When 2 Then 'Off-Season' Else null End
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail stockDetail
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and stockDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and stockDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on stockDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and stockDetail.SourceCode = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber and stockDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode
where stockDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and stockDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and stockDetail.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS PONO)Seasons ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionDetailID
,POH.NoteToVendor ,(Select top 1 Specs from PUR_QuotationHeader inner join PUR_QuotationDetail on PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID = PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID and PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID and PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID and PUR_QuotationDetail.FiscalID = PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID
inner join PUR_EnquiryDetail on PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.FiscalID = PUR_QuotationDetail.FiscalID and PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID
where PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = POH.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = POH.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo = POH.VendorQuoteNumber AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = POH.FromHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.FiscalID = POH.FiscalID )Specs FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
INNER JOIN [AR_SET_Customer] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[BusinessPartnerID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CustomerID] --AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
INNER join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID
LEFT join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader POH on [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID = POH.POHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = POH.DocumentNumber and INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = POH.TypeCode and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = POH.CompanyID
left join INV_GrossWeight on INV_GrossWeight.GrossWeightID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].GrossWeightID and INV_GrossWeight.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID and INV_GrossWeight.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].PeriodID and INV_GrossWeight.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID and INV_GrossWeight.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item POItem ON --POItem.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And POItem.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID Inner Join INV_SET_Category POCategory On (POCategory.CategoryID = POItem.ItemTypeID) --AND POCategory.CompanyID = POItem.CompanyID
LEFT JOin SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID=[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1
LEFT JOin SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=[INV_StockTransactionHeader].DepartmentID AND SET_Department.Status=1
left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID --and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumenttypeID
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] between @FromDate and @ToDate AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [SET_DocumentType].[MenuID] = (SELECT MenuID from ApplicationMenu where menuPath like '%Stock_frm.aspx%') and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].Status = 1

data.name: Query_ManualProduction
data.value: Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY FinTab.TransactionDetailID asc) RowUniqueID, FinTab.* From ( SELECT Distinct ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, 2) AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, Abs((case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ArrivedQuantity is null OR INV_StockTransactionDetail.ArrivedQuantity = 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity else INV_StockTransactionDetail.ArrivedQuantity end)) AS ArrivedQuantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) As TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReasonLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DistributionAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAccountCOA, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EncumbranceAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NewCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionType, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QuantityAdjusted, INV_StockTransactionDetail.EmployeeCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReceivingDocument, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.VendorLotNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShipmentNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.WayBillAirBill, INV_StockTransactionDetail.FreightCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.NoofContainers, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PercentageChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReservationLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.POQuantity, 2) AS POQuantity, ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierDCQuantity, 2) AS SupplierDCQuantity, ROUND(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ActualReceivedQuantity, 2) AS ActualReceivedQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShortQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.RejectedQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, INV_Item.Description, Set_Location.LocationID, Set_Location.LocationName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_Item.CostOfSalesAccountCCID AS AccountGINCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, '' AcceptQty, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID, SET_Rack.RackName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.QualityID, Set_Quality.QualityName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID as ShiftID, HRMS_Set_Shift.Description as ShiftDescription, AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.QtyRcvTolerance , INV_StockTransactionDetail.ExpiryDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.BatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShortLength, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Tail,INV_StockTransactionDetail.OverWeight,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Defected FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID left join SET_Rack on INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID = SET_Rack.RackID Left Join Set_Quality On INV_StockTransactionDetail.QualityID = Set_Quality.QualityID left join HRMS_Set_Shift on INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID = HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader On AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail On AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID Left Join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition On AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumenttypeID where [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = @StockTransactionID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = @Status ) As FinTab order by FinTab.[SerialNo] asc

data.name: Query_Stock_LedgerWithDoumentType
data.value:
Select * from ( Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo,
--cast(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,120)+' '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),INV_StockTransactionHeader.createdate,108) as datetime) DocumentDate,
INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,
SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as TransactionQuantity, 0 as TransactionCost, 0 AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount, 'opening' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,'' as DepartmentName ,'' as GL_Code FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader .CompanyID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} {3} AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ) as TAB {1}
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity,
--Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, ( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) - (( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1) ) / 100) ) as TransactionCost,
( (CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN -- Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) ELSE --AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) END ) - (( (CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN -- Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) as UnitPrice,
--SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) AS Amount,
( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) - (( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) AS Amount,
--SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity,
CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName , isnull(( select top 1 GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID from GL_TransactionHeader inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID where GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
),'') as GL_Code FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') ) inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader .CompanyID left join SET_Department on set_department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} {3} AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL
GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID ) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb where fintab.transactionquantity <> 0 {2}

select tab.Description as ItemDescription,
sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty,
--case when sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 then 0 else --sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceRate) / sum(Tab.OpeningBalanceQty)
--end as OpeningBalanceRate,
TAB.ItemID ,avg(TAB.TransactionCost)OpeningBalanceRate FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID) LocationID ,case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else null end as TransactionCost
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {3} AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) --GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description

select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, STD.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode ,STD.TransactionUOMID, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, STD.TransactionDetailID, case isnull(INV_Item.DownloadableFlag,0) when 0 then Round(ISNull((select top 1 INV_StockTransactionDetail.NewCost from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join Inv_StockTransactionHeader On Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.MenuID --And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' And ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Stock_frm.aspx' isnull(NewCost,0) > 0 Order By Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate desc),0),0) else isnull(inv_Item.ListPricePerUnit,0) end ) , 0) * (STD.TransactionQuantity), 0) AS Amount, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, ISNULL(STD.Comments, '') as Comments, ISNULL(STD.IsDone, 'false') as IsDone, ISNULL(STD.IsMajor, 'false') as IsMajor, STD.JobID,STD.JobCode, --Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity2, Cast(Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) AS decimal(18, 5)) as TransactionQuantity2,
Cast(Abs(STD.TransactionQuantity) - Abs(isnull( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) from INV_StockTransactionDetail Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = STD.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) AS decimal(18, 5)) as TransactionQuantity,
( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID left join Set_Location on Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID and Set_Location.Isactive = 1 and Set_Location.Status = 1 and Set_Location.IsWareHouse is null where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = STD.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = STD.CompanyId And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = STD.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND IsNull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode, 0) = 1 ) AS CurrentStock ,isnull(INV_Item.DownloadableFlag,0) as DownloadableFlag ,STD.CostCenterID,[SET_CostCenter].CostCenterName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID as HeaderCCID ,CC.CostCenterName as HeaderCCName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName, STD.Major, --SET_Rack.RackName, SET_Rack.RackID, INV_Item.CodeCombinationID, INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail2.Description as CodeDescription2 ,INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID as ItemCatalogID ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogDescription , (select Top 1 SET_Rack.RackName from SET_Rack inner join Set_RackItems on Set_Rack.RackID = Set_RackItems.RackID where Set_RackItems.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID ) as RackName
, (select Top 1 SET_Rack.RackID from SET_Rack inner join Set_RackItems on Set_Rack.RackID = Set_RackItems.RackID where Set_RackItems.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID ) as RackID FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail STD on STD.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and STD.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and STD.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = STD.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = STD.CompanyID Inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Requisition%' LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = STD.[TransactionUOMID] LEFT JOIN [SET_Currency] ON [SET_Currency].[CurrencyID] = STD.[CurrencyID] LEFT JOIN [SET_CostCenter] ON [SET_CostCenter].[CostCenterID] = STD.CostCenterID Left JOIN [SET_CostCenter] CC on CC.CostCenterID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID
LEFT JOIN [SET_Project] ON [SET_Project].[ProjectID] = STD.[ProjectID] LEFT JOIN AR_Set_Customer on AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].BusinessPartnerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Left Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID =INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID And SET_Location.Status=1 ---- GIN Quantuity -- left join INV_StockTransactionDetail GIN on GIN.SourceHEaderId = STD.StockTransactionID -- and GIN.SourceLineID = STD.TransactionDetailID -- and GIN.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GINHdr on GINHdr.StockTransactionID = STD.StockTransactionID -- left JOIN Set_DocumentType GinDoc ON GinDoc.DocumentTypeID = GINHdr.DocumentTypeID -- AND GinDoc.CompanyID = GINHdr.CompanyID AND GinDoc.PeriodID = GINHdr.PeriodID -- AND GinDoc.Status = 1 -- left Join ApplicationMenu GinMenu On GinMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID -- And GinMenu.MenuPath = '/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' -- and GINHdr.DocumentTypeID = GinDoc.DocumentTypeID
Left Join INV_Item Incrd ON Incrd.ItemID = STD.IncurredOnID
--left join Set_RackItems on Set_RackItems.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID ----and Set_RackItems.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID
--Inner Join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = Set_RackItems.RackID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID and INV_Item.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as GL_CodeCombinationDetail2 on GL_CodeCombinationDetail2.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID and INV_Item.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail2.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Where STD.Status = 1 ANd STD.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd STD.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and STD.TransactionQuantity > isnull(GIN.TransactionQuantity,0) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0}
) as tab where tab.TransactionQuantity2 > 0

data.name: Query_StockLedgerCategoryWise
data.value:
select tab.CategoryID, tab.CategoryName, sum(tab.OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount, sum(tab.AmountIn) as AmountIn, sum(tab.AmountOut) as AmountOut, ((sum(tab.OpeningAmount) + sum(tab.AmountIn)) - sum(tab.AmountOut)) as BalAmount
from (select CategoryID, CategoryName,
isnull((select sum(TransactionQuantity * TransactionCost) from (select DoctypeOpen.TransactionImpact, case DoctypeOpen.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact = 'Positive' then abs(stdopen.TransactionQuantity) when TransactionImpact = 'Negative' then abs(stdopen.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end end as TransactionQuantity, stdopen.TransactionCost from INV_StockTransactionHeader sthOpen INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail stdopen on stdopen.StockTransactionID = sthOpen.StockTransactionID And stdopen.CompanyID = sthOpen.CompanyID And stdopen.PeriodID = sthOpen.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType DoctypeOpen on DoctypeOpen.DocumentTypeID = sthOpen.DocumentTypeID And DoctypeOpen.CompanyID = sthOpen.CompanyID where sthOpen.CompanyID = 1 And stdopen.itemid = INV_Item.ItemID And stdopen.status = 1 And DoctypeOpen.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' And sthOpen.statusCode = 1 And sthOpen.DocumentDate <= @FromDate ) as Tab),0) as OpeningAmount,
isnull((select sum(TransactionQuantity * TransactionCost) from (select DoctypeIn.TransactionImpact, case DoctypeIn.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(stdIn.TransactionQuantity) else 0 end as TransactionQuantity, stdIn.TransactionCost from INV_StockTransactionHeader sthIn INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail stdIn on stdIn.StockTransactionID = sthIn.StockTransactionID And stdIn.CompanyID = sthIn.CompanyID And stdIn.[PeriodID] = sthIn.[PeriodID] INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType DoctypeIn on DoctypeIn.DocumentTypeID = sthIn.DocumentTypeID And DoctypeIn.CompanyID = sthIn.CompanyID where sthIn.CompanyID = 1 And stdIn.itemid = INV_Item.ItemID And stdIn.status = 1 And DoctypeIn.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' And DoctypeIn.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' And sthIn.statusCode = 1 And sthIn.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate ) as Tab),0) as AmountIn,
isnull((select sum(TransactionQuantity * TransactionCost) from (select DoctypeOut.TransactionImpact, case DoctypeOut.TransactionImpact when 'Negative' then abs(stdOut .TransactionQuantity) else 0 end as TransactionQuantity, stdOut.TransactionCost from INV_StockTransactionHeader sthOut INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail stdOut on stdOut.StockTransactionID = sthOut.StockTransactionID And stdOut.CompanyID = sthOut.CompanyID And stdOut.[PeriodID] = sthOut.[PeriodID] INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType DoctypeOut on DoctypeOut.DocumentTypeID = sthOut.DocumentTypeID And DoctypeOut.CompanyID = sthOut.CompanyID where sthOut.CompanyID = 1 And stdOut.itemid = INV_Item.ItemID And stdOut.status = 1 And DoctypeOut.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' And DoctypeOut.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' And sthOut.statusCode = 1 And sthOut.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate ) as Tab),0) as AmountOut
from INV_SET_Category INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID where --ItemID = 1883 (CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) {0} ) tab Group by tab.CategoryID, tab.CategoryName
