Select BankID, BankName, sum(OpeningAmount) + sum(ReceiptAmount) - sum(Payment) as BankBalance ,ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by BankID ASC) as 'Row' from ( select AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_SET_Bank.BankName,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, isnull( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + isnull( ( select sum(Case When AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount Else AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) - (isnull( ( select sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + isnull( ( select sum(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount Else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0)) OpeningAmount, isnull( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) Total from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID =AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID= AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) ReceiptAmount, ( ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) From AP_PaymentHeader --INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)
), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) ) Payment from AR_SET_BankAccount Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch On AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID AND AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 where AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport,0) = 1 ) Bank Group by BankID, BankName
UNION ALL
SELECT BankID, BankName, SUM(BankBalance), Row FROM ( Select 9999999 AS BankID, 'Total' AS BankName, sum(OpeningAmount) + sum(ReceiptAmount) - sum(Payment) as BankBalance ,9999999 as 'Row' from ( select AR_SET_Bank.BankID, AR_SET_Bank.BankName,AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, isnull( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + isnull( ( select sum(Case When AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount Else AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) - (isnull( ( select sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + isnull( ( select sum(Case When AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount Else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 End) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0)) OpeningAmount, isnull( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) Total from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Inner Join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID =AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID= AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID = AR_Set_bankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID is not null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) ReceiptAmount, ( ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) From AP_PaymentHeader --INNER JOIN AR_Set_bankAccount On AR_Set_bankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --And AR_Set_bankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --INNER JOIN AR_Set_BankBranch On AR_Set_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_Set_BankAccount.BankBranchID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID is not null AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID ), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail On AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)
), 0) + ISNULL( ( select sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) from AP_PaymentHeader INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID Is Not Null and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) ), 0) ) Payment from AR_SET_BankAccount Inner Join AR_SET_BankBranch On AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Bank ON AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID AND AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 where AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 and isnull(AR_SET_BankAccount.ShowInBankReport,0) = 1 ) Bank )FINTAB GROUP BY BankID, BankName, Row

data.name: Query_StockHeaderDetail_ByKey_ForSakrand
data.value:
SELECT Comments, CompanyID, PeriodID, TransactionDetailID, StockTransactionID, DefaultAccountCode, ItemID, ItemDescription, ItemUnitOfMeasureID, UOMName, AssetsAdditionFlag, BaseAmount, (Quantity - QuantityInvoiced) AS QuantityReturn, SerialNumber, UnitPrice, SourceHeaderID, SourceLineID, SourceCode, Action, LocationID FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( Select Distinct INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, NULL AS TransactionDetailID, NULL AS StockTransactionID, SET_DocumentType.DefaultAccountCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID as ItemUnitOfMeasureID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, NULL AS AssetsAdditionFlag, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit AS BaseAmount ,(TransactionQuantity - ISNull((Select abs(SUM(TransactionQuantity)) from INV_StockTransactionDetail StockGRND where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=StockGRND.SourceHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID=StockGRND.SourceLineID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID=StockGRND.ItemID ),0)) as Quantity ,
INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo AS SerialNumber,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost as UnitPrice, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID as SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID as SourceLineID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as SourceCode,'' AS Action,INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID, ISNULL(SUM(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced),0) AS QuantityInvoiced, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemID,0) AS InvoiceItem from INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID --INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID AND INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail On AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID
left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
where

Select Distinct INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategory, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName AS UOM, INV_Item.CompanyID, Sum( case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End ) As QtyInHand, IsNull(Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost), 0) As AvgPrice, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT As SellingPrice --, LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate As PODate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice As POPrice, -- LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName As POSupplier, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity As POQty, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate As StockTransDate, -- LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity As StockTransQty, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, -- LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog From INV_Item Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On INV_Item.ItemTypeID = Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = Inv_Set_Category.CompanyID And Inv_Set_Category.IsActive = 1 And Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID IN @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
Where INV_Item.Status = 1 --and INV_Item.CompanyID = @CompanyID And (Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
And ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') And (INV_Item.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID IS NULL)
{0}
Group by INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, INV_Item.MinimumQuantity, INV_Item.LISTPRICEPERUNIT, --LastPurchaseInfo.PurchaseOrderDate, LastPurchaseInfo.UnitPrice, LastPurchaseInfo.CustomerName, LastPurchaseInfo.Quantity, LastTransactionInfo.StockDate, --LastTransactionInfo.StockTransPrice, LastTransactionInfo.TransactionQuantity, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentType, LastTransactionInfo.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.CompanyID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description Order by SET_ItemCatalog.Description, Inv_Set_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description

select isnull(SUM(transactionquantity),0) as TransactionQuantity from ( Select TransactionQuantity from ( Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, 0 as TransactionQuantity, 0 as TransactionCost, 0 AS UnitPrice, 0 AS Amount, 'opening' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID = @GrainSizeID Or @GrainSizeID is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID = @PackTypeID Or @PackTypeID is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) -- AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) {0} AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID
) as TAB {1}
union all
Select * from ( SELECT Distinct [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled],SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, --SET_Location.LocationName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, --SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end as TransactionQuantity, Avg(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) TransactionCost, CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END AS UnitPrice, SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) AS Amount, --SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID is not null then case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' end else SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact end as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID = @GrainSizeID Or @GrainSizeID is null) and (INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID = @PackTypeID Or @PackTypeID is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID
) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb {2} ) as t

INV_StockTransactionDetail.PercentageChange, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ReservationLookup, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID, Item.Description +' '+isnull(Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,'') Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SET_Project.ProjectName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.InvoiceFlag, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PriorCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsMajor, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.HeadingCostCenterID, HeaderCostCenter.CostCenterName as HeadingCostCenterName, (Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END) Amount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsDone, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID, ( select sum(SumOfQuantityInStock ) from ( select case when StkDetail.ImpactID is not null then case StkDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end As SumOfQuantityInStock
from INV_StockTransactionDetail StkDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader StkHdr On StkHdr.StockTransactionID = StkDetail.StockTransactionID AND StkHdr.CompanyID = StkDetail.CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StkHdr.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StkHdr.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = StkHdr.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [StkDetail].LocationID
where StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and StkDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And StkDetail.Status = 1 And StkHdr.Status = 1 AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND StkDetail.IsActive = 1 AND StkHdr.StatusCode = 1 AND StkHdr.ReversalID IS NULL group by StkDetail.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,StkHdr.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType )as tab ) As CurrentStock, ( Select Sum(TransactionQuantity) From INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' Where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as Date) Between Cast(DateAdd(yy, -1, GetDate())as Date) AND CAST(GetDate() as Date) ) LastConsumption, ( Select top 1 UnitPrice as LastPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner Join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Item.ItemID Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc ) as LastPurchasePrice, '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID as DocumentTypeID, Item.ShelfReference, (Select Description from Inv_Item Where INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID) as IncurredDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsIncurred, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Remarks, Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID, SET_Location.LocationName as Location, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, case INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID when 1 then 'Positive' when 2 then 'Negative' else null end as Impact, Item.ListPricePerUnit, isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) TransactionCost ,(Case When Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost = 0 Then ISNULL(ISNULL(Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1), 0) Else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * (IsNull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, 0) * -1) END) CustomAmount, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.NoImpactQty ,(Select top 1 SET_Rack.RackID from Set_RackItems left join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID=Set_RackItems.RackID where Set_RackItems.ItemID = and SET_Rack.Status = 1) as RackName ,INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID as ItemCatalogID ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogDescription FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID
Left join SET_ItemCatalog On SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID Left Join SET_CostCenter HeaderCostCenter ON HeaderCostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.HeadingCostCenterID LEFT JOIN dbo.SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID LEFT JOIN dbo.SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
Order by INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID

data.name: Query_GRN_Inspection
data.value:
--DECLARE @CompanyID INT = 1, --@PeriodID INT = 1, --@ItemCategory INT = null, --@FromDate Date = '2024-10-01', --@ToDate Date = '2025-10-10';
SELECT
INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, isnull(SET_Location.LocationName,SL.LocationName) as LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,
SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)TransactionQuantity,
( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) - (( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1) ) / 100) ) as TransactionCost,
( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) - (( (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) as UnitPrice,
( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) - (( (SUM(ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)+ isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) ) * isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),0) ) / 100) ) AS Amount,
'Postive' as TransactionImpact,
INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, ISNULL((Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end), 1) UnitQuantity, CAST(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as DATE)CreateDate
,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName
,isnull(( select INV_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID from INV_Item where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID ),'') as GL_Code,
(CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments LIKE 'IR#%' AND LEN(INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments) <= 12 THEN INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ELSE '' END) AS Comments
,2 as TransactionImpactID,
CASE INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Approved' WHEN 5 THEN 'InProcess' WHEN 12 THEN 'ReleaseForApprove' WHEN 13 THEN 'PartiallyApproved' WHEN 14 THEN 'Discuss' WHEN 15 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 16 THEN 'Reversed' WHEN 17 THEN 'NoOrder' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS StatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
left join SET_Department on set_department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in (8,5,6,2,4,1,3) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) {0} AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL AND ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsForInspection, 0) = 1
GROUP BY INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PrimaryQuantity
